source.text: אַ֣לְלַי לִ֗י כִּ֤י הָיִ֨יתִי֙ כְּאָסְפֵּי־קַ֔יִץ כְּעֹלְלֹ֖ת בָּצִ֑יר אֵין־אֶשְׁכּ֣וֹל לֶאֱכ֔וֹל בִּכּוּרָ֖ה אִוְּתָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe to me! For I have become like [the] gatherings of summer fruit, like [the] gleanings of [the] grape harvest; there is no cluster to eat, [no] early fig [which] my soul craves.

en.L: Woe [is] me! For I have become like the gatherings of summer fruit, \q like the gleanings of the grape harvest; \q there is no cluster to eat, \q no early fig [that] my soul craves.
en.B: Woe is me! I am like one who comes when the summer fruit is gathered, \q when the grape harvest has been gleaned: \q not a cluster of grapes is left to eat, \q not one of the early figs I long for.
en.R: How terrible this is for me! \q I am like someone who goes to pick fruit after the harvest is over. \q There are no grapes left to eat, \q none of the early figs I long for.

vi.L: Khốn cho tôi! Vì tôi đã như [lúc] thu hái trái cây mùa hạ, \q như [lúc] mót nho sau mùa hái; \q chẳng còn chùm nho nào để ăn, \q chẳng còn trái vả đầu mùa mà linh hồn tôi thèm khát.
vi.B: Khốn cho tôi! Tôi giống như người đến khi trái cây mùa hạ đã hái xong, \q khi vườn nho đã mót sạch: \q chẳng còn một chùm nho nào để ăn, \q chẳng còn một trái vả đầu mùa nào tôi ao ước.
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho tôi! \q Tôi giống như người đi hái trái cây sau khi mùa gặt đã qua. \q Chẳng còn trái nho nào để ăn, \q chẳng còn trái vả đầu mùa nào tôi mong ước.

fr.L: Malheur à moi ! Car je suis devenu comme les récoltes des fruits d’été, \q comme le grappillage après la vendange ; \q il n’y a pas de grappe à manger, \q pas de figue précoce [que] mon âme désire.
fr.B: Malheur à moi ! Je suis comme celui qui vient quand on a cueilli les fruits d’été, \q quand on a grappillé après la vendange : \q il ne reste pas une grappe à manger, \q pas une des figues précoces que je désire tant.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour moi ! \q Je suis comme quelqu’un qui va cueillir des fruits quand la récolte est finie. \q Il ne reste plus de raisin à manger, \q plus aucune des premières figues que j’aime tant.

sw.L: Ole wangu! Kwa maana nimekuwa kama makusanyo ya matunda ya kiangazi, \q kama masazo ya mavuno ya zabibu; \q hakuna kishada cha kula, \q wala tini ya kwanza [ambayo] nafsi yangu inaitamani.
sw.B: Ole wangu! Nimekuwa kama mtu anayekuja baada ya matunda ya kiangazi kuvunwa, \q baada ya masazo ya mavuno ya zabibu kuokotwa: \q hakuna hata kishada kimoja cha zabibu kilichobaki cha kula, \q wala hata tini moja ya kwanza ninayoitamani.
sw.R: Mambo ni mabaya sana kwangu! \q Mimi ni kama mtu anayekwenda kuchuma matunda baada ya mavuno kwisha. \q Hakuna zabibu zilizobaki za kula, \q wala tini za kwanza ninazozitamani.

es.L: ¡Ay de mí! Porque he venido a ser como las recolecciones de la fruta de verano, \q como los rebuscos de la vendimia; \q no hay racimo que comer, \q ni breva [que] desea mi alma.
es.B: ¡Ay de mí! Soy como quien llega cuando ya se ha recogido la fruta de verano, \q cuando ya se ha rebuscado la vendimia: \q no queda ni un racimo para comer, \q ni uno de los higos tempranos que tanto deseo.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible es esto para mí! \q Soy como alguien que va a recoger fruta cuando la cosecha ya terminó. \q No quedan uvas para comer, \q ni ninguno de los primeros higos que tanto deseo.

ko.L: 내게 화가 있다! 나는 여름 과일을 거두어들인 뒤와 같고, \q 포도를 따고 난 뒤의 이삭줍기와 같이 되었다. \q 먹을 포도송이 하나 없고, \q 내 영혼이 몹시 바라는 첫 무화과도 없다.
ko.B: 아, 내 신세여! 나는 여름 과일을 다 거두어들인 뒤에 온 사람 같고, \q 포도를 다 딴 뒤에 이삭을 주우러 온 사람 같다. \q 먹을 포도송이 하나 남지 않았고, \q 내가 그토록 먹고 싶던 첫 무화과도 하나 없다.
ko.R: 아, 나는 이제 끝났다! \q 나는 추수가 다 끝난 뒤에 과일을 따러 간 사람과 같다. \q 먹을 포도가 하나도 남아 있지 않다. \q 내가 먹고 싶던 첫 무화과도 하나 없다.

decisions.choice: Woe is me: a cry of grief over one's own state
decisions.reason: The word is a rare cry of lament, found elsewhere only in Job 10:15. The speaker is the prophet, mourning over his people, though some hear Zion herself speaking, as she does openly in verses 8-10.

decisions.choice: like the gatherings of summer fruit: like a picker who comes after the harvest and finds nothing
decisions.reason: After the harvest and the gleaning, nothing is left on the trees and vines. So it is with the people: the prophet looks for one faithful person and finds none (verse 2). Jeremiah 5:1 searches Jerusalem the same way, and Isaiah 24:13 uses the picture of the gleaning.

decisions.choice: an early fig: the first ripe figs, a prized delicacy
decisions.reason: The first figs of the season ripen in early summer and were eagerly sought (Isaiah 28:4; Hosea 9:10). "My soul craves" means "I long for": the self, with all its desire.

decisions.choice: Woe [is] me (L); Woe is me (B); How terrible this is for me (R); the gatherings of summer fruit (L); one who comes when the summer fruit is gathered (B); someone who goes to pick fruit after the harvest is over (R)
decisions.reason: The cry follows the wording set for the prophets' "woe" said of oneself. Balanced and Readable say what the likeness means (m2).

decisions.choice: "Khốn cho tôi" (L, B); "Thật khốn khổ cho tôi" (R)
decisions.reason: The Isaiah note's wording for the cry said of oneself (Isaiah 6:5); the prophet speaks as "tôi".

decisions.choice: "Malheur à moi" (L, B), "Quel malheur pour moi !" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for the cry said of oneself.

decisions.choice: "Ole wangu!" (L, B); "Mambo ni mabaya sana kwangu!" (R)
decisions.reason: The cry over oneself as in 1 Kings 13:30 and the term sheet's hoy notes.

decisions.choice: "¡Ay de mí!" (L, B); "¡Qué terrible es esto para mí!" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Spanish for the cry said of oneself (Isaiah term sheet).

decisions.choice: "내게 화가 있다" (L); "아, 내 신세여" (B); "아, 나는 이제 끝났다" (R)
decisions.reason: A cry of grief over one's own state (meaning decision). As the term sheet for *hoy* of oneself (Isa 6:5): "내게 화가 있다" at Literal and "아, 나는 이제 끝났다" at Readable; Balanced uses a natural Korean lament, since "화가 있다" would sound like a threat.

source.text: אָבַ֤ד חָסִיד֙ מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְיָשָׁ֥ר בָּאָדָ֖ם אָ֑יִן כֻּלָּם֙ לְדָמִ֣ים יֶאֱרֹ֔בוּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־אָחִ֖יהוּ יָצ֥וּדוּ חֵֽרֶם׃

records.literal_gloss: Has perished [the] faithful from the land, and upright among humankind there is none; all of them for blood lie in wait; each his brother they hunt [with] a net.

en.L: The faithful has perished from the land, \q and there is no upright [one] among humankind; \q all of them lie in wait for blood; \q each hunts his brother [with] a net.
en.B: The faithful have vanished from the land; \q there is not one upright person left. \q They all lie in wait to shed blood; \q they hunt one another with nets.
en.R: Faithful people have disappeared from the land. \q There is no one left who does what is right. \q Everyone is waiting for a chance to kill. \q They set traps for one another.

vi.L: Người trung tín đã mất khỏi xứ, \q và chẳng có [người] ngay thẳng giữa loài người; \q hết thảy chúng đều rình rập để làm đổ máu; \q ai nấy giăng lưới săn bắt anh em mình.
vi.B: Người trung tín đã biến mất khỏi xứ; \q chẳng còn lại một người ngay thẳng nào. \q Hết thảy chúng đều rình chờ để làm đổ máu; \q chúng giăng lưới săn bắt lẫn nhau.
vi.R: Những người trung tín đã biến mất khỏi xứ. \q Chẳng còn ai làm điều ngay thẳng. \q Ai cũng chờ dịp để giết người. \q Chúng gài bẫy hại lẫn nhau.

fr.L: Le fidèle a disparu du pays, \q et il n’y a pas de [personne] droite parmi les humains ; \q tous guettent pour [verser le] sang ; \q chacun chasse son frère [avec] un filet.
fr.B: Les fidèles ont disparu du pays ; \q il ne reste pas une seule personne droite. \q Tous sont aux aguets pour verser le sang ; \q ils se chassent l’un l’autre au filet.
fr.R: Les gens fidèles ont disparu du pays. \q Il ne reste personne qui fasse ce qui est juste. \q Chacun attend l’occasion de tuer. \q Ils se tendent des pièges les uns aux autres.

sw.L: Mcha Mungu ametoweka katika nchi, \q wala hakuna mnyofu kati ya wanadamu; \q wote wanavizia damu; \q kila mtu anamwinda ndugu yake [kwa] wavu.
sw.B: Waaminifu wametoweka katika nchi; \q hakuna hata mtu mmoja mnyofu aliyebaki. \q Wote wanavizia ili kumwaga damu; \q wanawindana kwa nyavu.
sw.R: Watu waaminifu wametoweka katika nchi. \q Hakuna aliyebaki anayetenda yaliyo sawa. \q Kila mtu anangoja nafasi ya kuua. \q Wanategeana mitego.

es.L: Ha perecido el fiel de la tierra, \q y no hay [nadie] recto entre los seres humanos; \q todos ellos acechan para [derramar] sangre; \q cada uno caza a su hermano [con] red.
es.B: Los fieles han desaparecido de la tierra; \q no queda ni una persona recta. \q Todos acechan para derramar sangre; \q se cazan unos a otros con redes.
es.R: La gente fiel ha desaparecido de la tierra. \q No queda nadie que haga lo correcto. \q Todos esperan la oportunidad de matar. \q Se ponen trampas unos a otros.

ko.L: 신실한 자가 땅에서 사라졌고, \q 사람들 가운데 정직한 자가 없다. \q 그들은 모두 피를 노리고 숨어 기다리며, \q 각자 자기 형제를 그물로 사냥한다.
ko.B: 신실한 사람이 이 땅에서 사라졌고, \q 정직한 사람이 하나도 남지 않았다. \q 모두가 피를 흘리려고 숨어 기다리고, \q 서로 그물을 쳐서 사냥한다.
ko.R: 신실한 사람들이 이 땅에서 사라졌다. \q 옳은 일을 하는 사람이 하나도 남지 않았다. \q 모두가 사람을 죽일 기회만 노린다. \q 서로 덫을 놓는다.

decisions.choice: the faithful: the person who keeps loyal love
decisions.reason: The word is formed from *hesed*, loyal love (6:8). The faithful person is one who keeps faith with God and with others. None is left: this is the empty harvest of verse 1.

decisions.choice: lie in wait for blood: plot to kill or ruin others
decisions.reason: The words describe robbers waiting in ambush (Proverbs 1:11, 18). The prophet means not only murder but the ruin of the weak by the powerful, which he calls bloodshed (3:10).

decisions.choice: each hunts his brother with a net: they prey on one another
decisions.reason: "Each ... his brother" is the Hebrew way of saying "one another". The net is a hunter's or fowler's trap (Psalm 140:6). People treat their own kin as game to be caught.

decisions.choice: The faithful has (L); The faithful have (B); Faithful people (R); each hunts his brother (L); they hunt one another (B); They set traps for one another (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "each ... his brother"; Balanced and Readable give its sense, "one another", which includes men and women (m3).

source.text: עַל־הָרַ֤ע כַּפַּ֨יִם֙ לְהֵיטִ֔יב הַשַּׂ֣ר שֹׁאֵ֔ל וְהַשֹּׁפֵ֖ט בַּשִׁלּ֑וּםוְהַגָּד֗וֹל דֹּבֵ֨ר הַוַּ֥ת נַפְשׁ֛וֹ ה֖וּא וַֽיְעַבְּתֽוּהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: On the evil [are] both hands, to do [it] well; the official asks, and the judge for a bribe, and the great one speaks [the] desire of his soul, he; and they weave it.

en.L: Both hands [are] on evil, to do [it] well; \q the official asks, \q and the judge [asks] for a bribe; \q and the great man speaks the desire of his soul, and they weave it together.
en.B: Their hands are skilled at doing evil; \q the official makes demands, \q the judge asks for a bribe, \q and the powerful man speaks out what he craves, and together they twist it.
en.R: They are experts at doing evil. \q The leaders demand gifts. \q The judges ask for bribes. \q Powerful people get what they want, and they all plot together.

vi.L: Hai tay [chúng ở] trên điều ác, để làm [nó] cho giỏi; \q viên chức đòi hỏi, \q và quan xét [đòi] của hối lộ; \q người quyền thế nói ra điều lòng mình thèm muốn, và chúng cùng nhau đan dệt nó.
vi.B: Tay chúng thành thạo làm điều ác; \q viên chức đòi hỏi, \q quan xét đòi của hối lộ, \q kẻ quyền thế nói ra điều mình thèm muốn, và chúng cùng nhau bóp méo mọi việc.
vi.R: Chúng rất giỏi làm điều ác. \q Các nhà lãnh đạo đòi quà cáp. \q Các quan tòa đòi của hối lộ. \q Kẻ quyền thế muốn gì được nấy, và tất cả cùng nhau bày mưu tính kế.

fr.L: Les deux mains [sont] sur le mal, pour [le] bien faire ; \q le chef demande, \q et le juge [demande] un pot-de-vin ; \q et le grand dit le désir de son âme, et ils le trament ensemble.
fr.B: Leurs mains sont habiles à faire le mal ; \q le chef exige, \q le juge réclame un pot-de-vin, \q et le puissant dit tout haut ce qu’il convoite, et ensemble ils manigancent.
fr.R: Ils sont experts pour faire le mal. \q Les dirigeants exigent des cadeaux. \q Les juges demandent des pots-de-vin. \q Les puissants obtiennent ce qu’ils veulent, et tous complotent ensemble.

sw.L: Mikono yote miwili [iko] juu ya ubaya, ili kuutenda vizuri; \q afisa anadai, \q na mwamuzi [anadai] rushwa; \q na mkubwa anasema tamaa ya nafsi yake, nao wanalisuka pamoja.
sw.B: Mikono yao ni stadi kutenda mabaya; \q afisa anadai, \q mwamuzi anaomba rushwa, \q na mwenye nguvu anatamka anachokitamani, nao kwa pamoja wanalipotosha.
sw.R: Wao ni hodari sana katika kutenda maovu. \q Viongozi wanadai zawadi. \q Waamuzi wanaomba rushwa. \q Wenye nguvu wanapata wanachotaka, nao wote wanapanga hila pamoja.

es.L: Para el mal [están] ambas manos, para hacer[lo] bien; \q el príncipe pide, \q y el juez [pide] soborno; \q y el grande habla del deseo de su alma, y lo tejen juntos.
es.B: Sus manos son hábiles para hacer el mal; \q el jefe exige, \q el juez pide soborno, \q y el poderoso dice lo que se le antoja, y juntos lo tuercen.
es.R: Son expertos en hacer el mal. \q Los dirigentes exigen regalos. \q Los jueces piden sobornos. \q Los poderosos consiguen lo que quieren, y todos traman juntos.

ko.L: 두 손이 악에 [있어] 그것을 잘 행한다. \q 관리는 요구하고, \q 재판관은 뇌물을 [요구하며], \q 세력가는 자기 영혼의 욕심을 말하니, 그들이 그것을 함께 엮는다.
ko.B: 그들의 손은 악한 일을 하는 데 능숙하다. \q 관리는 무엇을 내놓으라 하고, \q 재판관은 뇌물을 달라 하며, \q 세력가는 자기 욕심을 드러내니, 그들이 함께 일을 꾸며 낸다.
ko.R: 그들은 악한 일을 하는 데 선수다. \q 지도자들은 선물을 요구한다. \q 재판관들은 뇌물을 달라고 한다. \q 힘 있는 사람들은 원하는 것을 다 얻는다. 그들은 모두 함께 음모를 꾸민다.

decisions.choice: both hands on evil, to do it well: they are eager and skilled at wrongdoing
decisions.reason: Using both hands means giving full effort. "To do it well" is said with irony: the only thing they do well is evil. The Hebrew of the line is short and its exact construction uncertain, but the sense is clear.

decisions.choice: the official asks, and the judge for a bribe: justice is for sale
decisions.reason: Officials and judges were meant to protect the weak, and the law forbade bribes (Exodus 23:8; Deuteronomy 16:19). Here they demand payment (compare 3:11; Amos 5:12). "The great man" is the powerful noble who gets what he wants by saying so.

decisions.choice: they weave it together: they conspire
decisions.reason: The verb is found only here and seems to mean to twist or weave together. The official, the judge and the great man work together to get what each wants.

decisions.choice: official (L, B); leaders (R); great man (L); powerful man (B); Powerful people (R); weave it together (L); twist it (B); plot together (R)
decisions.reason: The word for official follows the wording set for the prophets. "Great man" and "powerful man" name one figure, a male noble; Readable makes the three figures plural, as a class.

decisions.choice: sar "le chef" (L, B), "les dirigeants" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for sarim in the Twelve.

decisions.choice: "el príncipe" (L); "el jefe" (B); "los dirigentes" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Spanish for a human sar in the prophets, where the English Twelve has "official" (term sheet, uncertain).

decisions.choice: *sar* "관리" (L, B); "지도자" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet gives "고관 / 관리 / 지도자" for *sar(im)*; here the official sits beside the judge, so Literal also says "관리".

source.text: טוֹבָ֣ם כְּחֵ֔דֶק יָשָׁ֖ר מִמְּסוּכָ֑ה י֤וֹם מְצַפֶּ֨יךָ֙ פְּקֻדָּתְךָ֣ בָ֔אָה עַתָּ֥ה תִהְיֶ֖ה מְבוּכָתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] best of them [is] like a brier, [the] upright more than a thorn hedge; [the] day of your watchmen, your punishment, has come; now will be their confusion.

en.L: The best of them [is] like a brier, \q the most upright worse than a thorn hedge. \q The day of your watchmen, your punishment, has come; \q now their confusion will be.
en.B: The best of them is like a brier, \q the most upright worse than a hedge of thorns. \q The day your watchmen warned of has come, the day of your punishment; \q now is the time of their confusion.
en.R: Even the best of them are like thorny weeds. \q The most honest of them are worse than a hedge of thorns. \q The day your prophets warned you about has come. God is going to punish you. \q Now everyone will be confused and afraid.

vi.L: Người tốt nhất của chúng [như] bụi gai, \q người ngay thẳng nhất còn tệ hơn hàng rào gai góc. \q Ngày của những người canh gác ngươi, ngày ngươi bị trừng phạt, đã đến; \q bây giờ sẽ là lúc chúng rối loạn.
vi.B: Người tốt nhất trong chúng như bụi gai, \q người ngay thẳng nhất còn tệ hơn hàng rào gai. \q Ngày mà những người canh gác ngươi đã cảnh báo đã đến, ngày ngươi bị trừng phạt; \q bây giờ là lúc chúng hoảng loạn.
vi.R: Ngay cả người tốt nhất trong chúng cũng như bụi cỏ gai. \q Người ngay thật nhất còn tệ hơn hàng rào gai. \q Ngày mà các tiên tri đã cảnh báo các ngươi đã đến. Đức Chúa Trời sắp trừng phạt các ngươi. \q Bây giờ mọi người sẽ hoang mang và sợ hãi.

fr.L: Le meilleur d’entre eux [est] comme une ronce, \q le plus droit pire qu’une haie d’épines. \q Le jour de tes sentinelles, ton châtiment, est venu ; \q maintenant sera leur confusion.
fr.B: Le meilleur d’entre eux est comme une ronce, \q le plus droit pire qu’une haie d’épines. \q Le jour annoncé par tes sentinelles est venu, le jour de ton châtiment ; \q voici maintenant le temps de leur confusion.
fr.R: Même les meilleurs d’entre eux sont comme des ronces. \q Les plus honnêtes sont pires qu’une haie d’épines. \q Le jour dont tes prophètes t’avaient averti est arrivé. Dieu va te punir. \q Maintenant, tout le monde sera perdu et aura peur.

sw.L: Aliye bora kati yao [ni] kama mbigili, \q aliye mnyofu kabisa ni mbaya kuliko ua wa miiba. \q Siku ya walinzi wako, adhabu yako, imefika; \q sasa kutakuwa na fadhaa yao.
sw.B: Aliye bora kati yao ni kama mbigili, \q aliye mnyofu kabisa ni mbaya kuliko ua wa miiba. \q Siku ambayo walinzi wako walionya juu yake imefika, siku ya adhabu yako; \q sasa ni wakati wa fadhaa yao.
sw.R: Hata walio bora kati yao ni kama magugu yenye miiba. \q Walio waaminifu zaidi ni wabaya kuliko ua wa miiba. \q Siku ambayo manabii wako walikuonya juu yake imefika. Mungu anakwenda kukuadhibu. \q Sasa kila mtu atachanganyikiwa na kuogopa.

es.L: El mejor de ellos [es] como un espino, \q el más recto, peor que un seto de espinas. \q El día de tus centinelas, tu castigo, ha llegado; \q ahora será su confusión.
es.B: El mejor de ellos es como una zarza, \q el más recto, peor que un seto de espinos. \q Ha llegado el día que anunciaron tus centinelas, el día de tu castigo; \q ahora es el tiempo de su confusión.
es.R: Aun los mejores de ellos son como hierbas espinosas. \q Los más honrados son peores que un seto de espinos. \q Ha llegado el día del que te advirtieron tus profetas. Dios te va a castigar. \q Ahora todos estarán confundidos y con miedo.

ko.L: 그들 가운데 가장 좋은 자도 찔레 같고, \q 가장 정직한 자도 가시 울타리보다 더하다. \q 너의 파수꾼들의 날, 너의 형벌의 날이 왔으니, \q 이제 그들이 혼란에 빠질 것이다.
ko.B: 그들 가운데 가장 나은 사람도 찔레 같고, \q 가장 정직한 사람도 가시 울타리보다 더 고약하다. \q 너의 파수꾼들이 경고하던 날, 네가 벌을 받는 날이 왔다. \q 이제 그들이 큰 혼란에 빠질 때이다.
ko.R: 그들 가운데 가장 착한 사람도 가시덤불 같다. \q 가장 정직한 사람도 가시 울타리보다 더 나쁘다. \q 예언자들이 너희에게 경고하던 날이 왔다. 하나님께서 너희를 벌하실 것이다. \q 이제 모두 갈팡질팡하며 두려워할 것이다.

decisions.choice: like a brier ... a thorn hedge: they wound anyone who comes near
decisions.reason: A brier and a thorn hedge scratch and tear whoever touches them. Even the best of these people are like that: dealing with them brings only harm.

decisions.choice: the day of your watchmen: the day the prophets warned of
decisions.reason: Prophets are called watchmen, who look out and warn of danger (Jeremiah 6:17; Ezekiel 3:17; Hosea 9:8). The day they warned of is the day of punishment, and it has come. "Your" is singular, spoken to the people as one.

decisions.choice: their confusion: the panic of a people in disaster
decisions.reason: The word means confusion and dismay, as when an army is thrown into panic (Isaiah 22:5).

decisions.choice: The day your watchmen warned of ... the day of your punishment (B); The day your prophets warned you about ... God is going to punish you (R); confused and afraid (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the day of your watchmen" means (m2); Readable names the watchmen as prophets and God as the one who punishes.

decisions.choice: "những người canh gác" (L, B); "các tiên tri" (R)
decisions.reason: "Người canh gác" is the terms note's word for the prophetic watchman (Jeremiah 6:17); Readable names the prophets, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "walinzi"
decisions.reason: The watchmen (tsofeh) as in Isaiah 21:11 and the term sheet; Readable names them as the prophets, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "tus centinelas" (L, B); "tus profetas" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Spanish for tsofeh, the watchman, is "centinela"; Readable names whom the picture means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "파수꾼" (L, B); "예언자들" (R) for the watchmen
decisions.reason: As the term sheet [Jer 6:17]; the watchmen are the prophets who warned of this day (meaning decision), as the English Readable says.

source.text: אַל־תַּאֲמִ֣ינוּ בְרֵ֔עַ אַֽל־תִּבְטְח֖וּ בְּאַלּ֑וּף מִשֹּׁכֶ֣בֶת חֵיקֶ֔ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר פִּתְחֵי־פִֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not believe in a neighbor; do not trust in a close friend; from her who lies in your bosom guard [the] openings of your mouth.

en.L: Do not believe in a neighbor; \q do not trust in a close friend; \q from her who lies in your bosom \q guard the doors of your mouth.
en.B: Do not trust a neighbor; \q put no confidence in a friend. \q Even with the woman who lies in your arms, \q guard the doors of your mouth.
en.R: Do not trust your neighbors. \q Do not depend on your friends. \q Be careful what you say, \q even to your own wife.

vi.L: Đừng tin người lân cận; \q đừng cậy bạn thân; \q với người nằm trong lòng ngươi, \q hãy canh giữ cửa miệng ngươi.
vi.B: Đừng tin người lân cận; \q chớ cậy bạn bè. \q Ngay cả với người đàn bà nằm trong vòng tay ngươi, \q hãy giữ gìn cửa miệng.
vi.R: Đừng tin người lân cận. \q Đừng cậy vào bạn bè. \q Hãy cẩn thận lời mình nói, \q ngay cả với chính vợ mình.

fr.L: Ne croyez pas en un voisin ; \q ne vous fiez pas à un ami intime ; \q devant celle qui couche sur ton sein, \q garde les portes de ta bouche.
fr.B: Ne faites pas confiance à un voisin ; \q ne comptez pas sur un ami. \q Même devant la femme qui dort dans tes bras, \q garde les portes de ta bouche.
fr.R: Ne faites pas confiance à vos voisins. \q Ne comptez pas sur vos amis. \q Fais attention à ce que tu dis, \q même à ta propre femme.

sw.L: Msimwamini jirani; \q msimtegemee rafiki wa karibu; \q kwa yeye alalaye kifuani mwako \q linda milango ya kinywa chako.
sw.B: Usimwamini jirani; \q usimtumainie rafiki. \q Hata kwa mwanamke alalaye mikononi mwako, \q linda milango ya kinywa chako.
sw.R: Usiwaamini majirani zako. \q Usiwategemee rafiki zako. \q Uwe mwangalifu kwa unayosema, \q hata kwa mke wako mwenyewe.

es.L: No {{plural_you:crean|creáis}} en el prójimo; \q no {{plural_you:confíen|confiéis}} en el amigo íntimo; \q de la que duerme en tu regazo \q guarda las puertas de tu boca.
es.B: No {{plural_you:confíen|confiéis}} en el vecino; \q no {{plural_you:se fíen|os fiéis}} del amigo. \q Aun con la mujer que duerme en tus brazos, \q guarda las puertas de tu boca.
es.R: {{plural_you:No confíen en sus vecinos|No confiéis en vuestros vecinos}}. \q {{plural_you:No dependan de sus amigos|No dependáis de vuestros amigos}}. \q Ten cuidado con lo que dices, \q aun a tu propia esposa.

ko.L: 이웃을 믿지 말고, \q 가까운 친구도 신뢰하지 마라. \q 네 품에 누운 여자에게도 \q 네 입의 문을 지켜라.
ko.B: 이웃을 믿지 말고, \q 친구도 신뢰하지 마라. \q 네 품에 안겨 누운 여자 앞에서도 \q 네 입의 문을 지켜라.
ko.R: 너희 이웃을 믿지 마라. \q 친구도 의지하지 마라. \q 너희 아내에게조차 \q 말을 조심하여라.

decisions.choice: her who lies in your bosom: one's own wife
decisions.reason: The phrase names the closest of all relationships (Deuteronomy 13:7, "the wife of your bosom"). When even she cannot be trusted with a secret, society has fallen apart.

decisions.choice: guard the doors of your mouth: be careful what you say
decisions.reason: The mouth is pictured as a door to be guarded (Psalm 141:3). In a society of informers, a careless word could be used against the speaker.

decisions.choice: her who lies in your bosom (L); the woman who lies in your arms (B); your own wife (R); doors of your mouth (L, B); Be careful what you say (R)
decisions.reason: The warning is spoken to a man, so "her" is his wife; Readable says so (m1) and explains the guarded door (m2).

decisions.choice: the warnings speak to each hearer as "ngươi" (L, B) and with no pronoun at R
decisions.reason: The prophet warns his hearers one by one, as the Hebrew singular does; Readable's "mình" keeps it general.

decisions.choice: plural_you for the first two commands, then "tú"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew commands are plural and then turn to one person ("your bosom"); Spanish follows the Hebrew.

source.text: כִּֽי־בֵן֙ מְנַבֵּ֣ל אָ֔ב בַּ֚ת קָמָ֣ה בְאִמָּ֔הּ כַּלָּ֖ה בַּחֲמֹתָ֑הּ אֹיְבֵ֥י אִ֖ישׁ אַנְשֵׁ֥י בֵיתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For a son treats with contempt a father; a daughter rises up against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; [the] enemies of a man [are the] men of his house.

en.L: For a son treats [his] father with contempt, \q a daughter rises up against her mother, \q a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; \q the enemies of {{gender:a person|a man}} [are] the {{gender:people|men}} of {{gender:their|his}} own house.
en.B: For a son treats his father with contempt, \q a daughter rises against her mother, \q a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; \q {{gender:a person's|a man's}} enemies are the {{gender:people|men}} of {{gender:their|his}} own household.
en.R: Sons treat their fathers like fools. \q Daughters turn against their mothers, \q and daughters-in-law against their mothers-in-law. \q Your enemies are the people in your own family.

vi.L: Vì con trai khinh dể cha, \q con gái nổi lên chống mẹ, \q con dâu chống mẹ chồng; \q kẻ thù của một người [là] người nhà của mình.
vi.B: Vì con trai khinh thường cha, \q con gái chống lại mẹ, \q con dâu chống lại mẹ chồng; \q kẻ thù của một người chính là người trong nhà mình.
vi.R: Con trai coi cha mình như kẻ ngu dại. \q Con gái chống lại mẹ, \q con dâu chống lại mẹ chồng. \q Kẻ thù của các ngươi là chính những người trong gia đình mình.

fr.L: Car le fils traite [son] père avec mépris, \q la fille se dresse contre sa mère, \q la belle-fille contre sa belle-mère ; \q les ennemis de {{gender:chacun|l’homme}} [sont] les gens de sa propre maison.
fr.B: Car le fils méprise son père, \q la fille se dresse contre sa mère, \q la belle-fille contre sa belle-mère ; \q chacun a pour ennemis les gens de sa propre maison.
fr.R: Les fils traitent leur père comme un imbécile. \q Les filles se dressent contre leur mère, \q et les belles-filles contre leur belle-mère. \q Tes ennemis sont les gens de ta propre famille.

sw.L: Kwa maana mwana anamdharau baba, \q binti anainuka dhidi ya mama yake, \q mkwe dhidi ya mama mkwe wake; \q adui za mtu [ni] watu wa nyumbani mwake mwenyewe.
sw.B: Kwa maana mwana anamdharau baba yake, \q binti anainuka dhidi ya mama yake, \q mkwe dhidi ya mama mkwe wake; \q adui za mtu ni watu wa nyumbani mwake mwenyewe.
sw.R: Wana wanawadharau baba zao. \q Binti wanawapinga mama zao, \q na wakwe wanawapinga mama wakwe zao. \q Adui zako ni watu wa jamaa yako mwenyewe.

es.L: Porque el hijo deshonra al padre, \q la hija se levanta contra su madre, \q la nuera contra su suegra; \q los enemigos {{gender:de la persona|del hombre}} [son] los de su casa.
es.B: Porque el hijo trata con desprecio a su padre, \q la hija se levanta contra su madre, \q la nuera contra su suegra; \q los enemigos de cada uno son los de su propia familia.
es.R: Los hijos tratan a sus padres como tontos. \q Las hijas se ponen en contra de sus madres, \q y las nueras en contra de sus suegras. \q Tus enemigos son los de tu propia familia.

ko.L: 아들이 [자기] 아버지를 업신여기고, \q 딸이 자기 어머니를 거슬러 일어나며, \q 며느리가 자기 시어머니를 [거슬러 일어난다]. \q 사람의 원수는 자기 집안 식구들이다.
ko.B: 아들이 아버지를 업신여기고, \q 딸이 어머니에게 대들며, \q 며느리가 시어머니에게 대든다. \q 사람의 원수가 바로 자기 집안 식구들이다.
ko.R: 아들들이 아버지를 바보 취급한다. \q 딸들이 어머니에게 등을 돌리고, \q 며느리들이 시어머니에게 등을 돌린다. \q 너희의 원수는 바로 너희 가족이다.

decisions.choice: son against father ... a man's enemies are his own household: words Jesus takes up in Matthew 10:35-36
decisions.reason: Jesus says that he has come to set a man against his father, a daughter against her mother and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law, and that a person's enemies will be those of his own household (Matthew 10:35-36; compare Luke 12:53). He uses Micah's words to describe the division that following him will bring even within families. In Micah they describe a society where every bond of trust has broken.

decisions.choice: treats with contempt: treats as a fool, dishonors
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the word for a fool, one who has no regard for God or for what is right (Deuteronomy 32:15; Psalm 14:1). The son breaks the command to honor father and mother (Exodus 20:12).

decisions.choice: a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law: the household that should have been one
decisions.reason: A married son and his wife usually lived in his parents' household. The "men of his house" are all who belong to it, men and women alike. The family, the first place of loyalty, has become a place of enemies.

decisions.choice: the enemies of a person ... the people of their own house (with the gender setting, L, B); Your enemies ... your own family (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "man" and "men of his house" mean any person and all the members of a household, so Literal and Balanced have the gender setting. Readable says "your", meaning anyone. Readable makes the three pairs plural.

decisions.choice: "kẻ thù của một người ... người nhà của mình", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Một người", "người nhà" and "mình" include men and women, so the English gender spans have no Vietnamese counterpart. The meaning decision names Matthew 10:35-36, where the published Vietnamese has "người nhà mình"; the same words are kept.

decisions.choice: "les ennemis de {{gender:chacun|l'homme}} [sont] les gens de sa propre maison" (L), the published Matthew 10:36 Literal; Balanced "chacun" and "les gens" with no setting
decisions.reason: Jesus takes up this verse in Matthew 10:35-36; French keeps the published key words. "Chacun" and "les gens" are already inclusive, so Balanced needs none of the English gender spans.

decisions.choice: "adui za mtu ni watu wa nyumbani mwake" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Mtu", "watu" and "-ake" already include women and men, so the English gender spans have no Swahili counterpart. Jesus takes up the line in Matthew 10:36.

decisions.choice: "los enemigos {{gender:de la persona|del hombre}} [son] los de su casa" (L); "los enemigos de cada uno son los de su propia familia" (B)
decisions.reason: Jesus takes up these words in Matthew 10:36, so Literal and Balanced reuse its Spanish; Balanced "cada uno" already includes women and needs no span.

decisions.choice: "사람의 원수는 자기 집안 식구들이다", with no gender span, as the Korean Matthew 10:36
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" and "식구" include men and women, so the English gender spans have nothing to change. Jesus takes up these words in Matthew 10:35-36 (meaning decision); Korean keeps the Korean Matthew's "며느리 … 시어머니" and "사람의 원수 … 자기 집안 식구" so the quotation can be seen.

source.text: וַאֲנִי֙ בַּיהוָ֣ה אֲצַפֶּ֔ה אוֹחִ֖ילָה לֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י יִשְׁמָעֵ֖נִי אֱלֹהָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: But I, for Yahweh I will watch; I will wait for [the] God of my salvation; my God will hear me.

en.L: But as for me, I will watch for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q I will hope for the God of my salvation; \q my God will hear me.
en.B: But I will keep watch for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q I will put my hope in the God who saves me; \q my God will hear me.
en.R: But I will look to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help. \q I will wait for God to save me. \q My God will hear me.

vi.L: Còn tôi, tôi sẽ trông chờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q tôi sẽ đợi chờ Đức Chúa Trời của sự cứu rỗi tôi; \q Đức Chúa Trời tôi sẽ nghe tôi.
vi.B: Nhưng tôi sẽ trông chờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q tôi đặt hy vọng nơi Đức Chúa Trời là Đấng cứu tôi; \q Đức Chúa Trời tôi sẽ nghe tôi.
vi.R: Nhưng tôi sẽ trông cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ. \q Tôi sẽ chờ đợi Đức Chúa Trời cứu tôi. \q Đức Chúa Trời của tôi sẽ nghe tôi.

fr.L: Mais moi, je guetterai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q j’espérerai dans le Dieu de mon salut ; \q mon Dieu m’entendra.
fr.B: Mais moi, je resterai aux aguets, attendant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q je mets mon espoir dans le Dieu qui me sauve ; \q mon Dieu m’entendra.
fr.R: Mais moi, je compterai sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour m’aider. \q J’attendrai que Dieu me sauve. \q Mon Dieu m’entendra.

sw.L: Lakini mimi, nitamtazamia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q nitamngoja Mungu wa wokovu wangu; \q Mungu wangu atanisikia.
sw.B: Lakini mimi nitakesha nikimtazamia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q nitaweka tumaini langu kwa Mungu anayeniokoa; \q Mungu wangu atanisikia.
sw.R: Lakini mimi nitamtazamia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anisaidie. \q Nitamngoja Mungu aniokoe. \q Mungu wangu atanisikia.

es.L: Pero yo, {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} vigilaré; \q esperaré al Dios de mi salvación; \q mi Dios me oirá.
es.B: Pero yo estaré atento {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; \q pondré mi esperanza en el Dios que me salva; \q mi Dios me escuchará.
es.R: Pero yo buscaré la ayuda {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q Esperaré a que Dios me salve. \q Mi Dios me escuchará.

ko.L: 그러나 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 바라보며, \q 나의 구원의 하나님을 기다릴 것이다. \q 나의 하나님께서 내 말을 들으실 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 우러러보며, \q 나를 구원하시는 하나님을 기다리겠다. \q 나의 하나님께서 내 말을 들어 주실 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 도와주시기를 바라보겠다. \q 하나님께서 나를 구원해 주시기를 기다리겠다. \q 나의 하나님께서 내 말을 들어 주실 것이다.

decisions.choice: But as for me: the turning point of the chapter
decisions.reason: In a land where no one can be trusted (verses 2-6), the speaker turns to the one who can be. The words "but as for me" set him against everything before, as in 3:8. From here the chapter moves from lament to trust and praise.

decisions.choice: I will watch ... I will wait: look out with expectation for the LORD to act
decisions.reason: The first verb is the work of a watchman (verse 4) looking out from a tower; the second means to wait in hope (Psalm 130:5-6; Habakkuk 2:1). The prophet watches, not for disaster, but for the LORD's salvation.

decisions.choice: watch for (L); keep watch for (B); look to ... for help (R); the God of my salvation (L, B); God to save me (R)
decisions.reason: The word for salvation follows the wording set for the prophets. Readable says what watching for the LORD means (m2).

decisions.choice: 7:7-10 in the plain style with "나", speaking about the LORD with -시-; 7:14-20 turns to God in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: The speaker (the prophet, and Zion with him) speaks about the LORD and to the enemy here, and prays to the LORD from 7:14; Korean follows each turn, as in the Psalms.

source.text: אַֽל־תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י אֹיַ֨בְתִּי֙ לִ֔י כִּ֥י נָפַ֖לְתִּי קָ֑מְתִּי כִּֽי־אֵשֵׁ֣ב בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ יְהוָ֖ה א֥וֹר לִֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Do not rejoice, my enemy, over me; though I have fallen, I will rise; though I sit in darkness, Yahweh [is] a light for me.

en.L: Do not rejoice over me, my enemy; \q though I have fallen, I will rise; \q though I sit in darkness, \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] a light for me.
en.B: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! \q I have fallen, but I will rise. \q Though I sit in darkness, \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is my light.
en.R: My enemy, do not laugh at me! \q I have fallen, but I will get up again. \q I am sitting in darkness, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be my light.

vi.L: Hỡi kẻ thù của tôi, đừng vui mừng vì tôi; \q dù tôi đã ngã, tôi sẽ đứng dậy; \q dù tôi ngồi trong bóng tối, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] ánh sáng cho tôi.
vi.B: Hỡi kẻ thù của tôi, đừng hả hê vì tôi! \q Tôi đã ngã, nhưng tôi sẽ đứng dậy. \q Dù tôi ngồi trong bóng tối, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là ánh sáng của tôi.
vi.R: Hỡi kẻ thù của tôi, đừng cười nhạo tôi! \q Tôi đã ngã, nhưng tôi sẽ lại đứng lên. \q Tôi đang ngồi trong bóng tối, \q nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ là ánh sáng của tôi.

fr.L: Ne te réjouis pas à mon sujet, mon ennemie ; \q si je suis tombée, je me relèverai ; \q si je suis assise dans les ténèbres, \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] une lumière pour moi.
fr.B: Ne te réjouis pas de mon malheur, mon ennemie ! \q Je suis tombée, mais je me relèverai. \q Même si je suis assise dans les ténèbres, \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est ma lumière.
fr.R: Mon ennemie, ne te moque pas de moi ! \q Je suis tombée, mais je me relèverai. \q Je suis assise dans le noir, \q mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera ma lumière.

sw.L: Usifurahi juu yangu, ewe adui yangu; \q ingawa nimeanguka, nitainuka; \q ingawa ninaketi gizani, \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] nuru kwangu.
sw.B: Usinicheke kwa kunidharau, ewe adui yangu! \q Nimeanguka, lakini nitainuka. \q Ingawa ninaketi gizani, \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni nuru yangu.
sw.R: Adui yangu, usinicheke! \q Nimeanguka, lakini nitasimama tena. \q Ninaketi gizani, \q lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa nuru yangu.

es.L: No te alegres de mí, enemiga mía; \q aunque caí, me levantaré; \q aunque more en tinieblas, \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] luz para mí.
es.B: ¡No te burles de mí, enemiga mía! \q He caído, pero me levantaré. \q Aunque esté sentada en tinieblas, \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es mi luz.
es.R: ¡Enemiga mía, no te rías de mí! \q He caído, pero me volveré a levantar. \q Estoy sentada en la oscuridad, \q pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será mi luz.

ko.L: 나의 원수야, 나 때문에 기뻐하지 마라. \q 내가 넘어졌어도 일어날 것이다. \q 내가 어둠 속에 앉아 있어도 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나의 빛이 되신다.
ko.B: 나의 원수야, 나를 보고 고소해하지 마라! \q 내가 넘어졌으나 다시 일어날 것이다. \q 내가 어둠 속에 앉아 있어도 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나의 빛이시다.
ko.R: 나의 원수야, 나를 비웃지 마라! \q 내가 넘어졌지만 다시 일어날 것이다. \q 내가 어둠 속에 앉아 있지만 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나의 빛이 되어 주실 것이다.

decisions.choice: my enemy: Zion speaks to a rival city, both pictured as women
decisions.reason: In verses 8-10 the speaker is Zion, the people of God, and "my enemy" is feminine: a hostile nation or city, pictured as a woman, which gloats over her fall. The text does not name it; Babylon, Edom and Nineveh have all been suggested.

decisions.choice: darkness ... light: distress, and the LORD's rescue
decisions.reason: Darkness is a picture of disaster and captivity, light of rescue and life (Psalm 27:1; Isaiah 9:1). Zion has fallen and sits in the dark, but she does not despair.

decisions.choice: rejoice over (L); gloat over (B); laugh at (R); [is] a light for me (L); is my light (B); will be my light (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the enemy's joy is: gloating over another's fall. The Hebrew has no verb in the last line; Readable puts it in the future, as the promise it is.

decisions.choice: Zion speaks as "tôi" and calls the rival city "kẻ thù của tôi", "nó" in 7:10
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: Zion speaks to a rival city, both pictured as women. The terms note keeps "nàng" for Zion and gives "nó" for a foreign city.

decisions.choice: Zion speaks and is spoken to as a woman in 7:8-10: feminine agreement ("je suis tombée", "mon ennemie")
decisions.reason: As the English meaning decision explains, Zion and the rival city are both pictured as women; the term sheet keeps feminine agreement for personified cities.

decisions.choice: "nuru"
decisions.reason: "Nuru" rather than everyday "mwanga", since the LORD's light is a figure for rescue (style guide).

decisions.choice: "enemiga mía"; feminine "sentada" for the speaker
decisions.reason: Zion and the rival city are both pictured as women, so Spanish uses feminine agreement for each.

decisions.choice: "나의 원수야", never "그녀" for the enemy city
decisions.reason: Zion speaks to a rival city, both pictured as women (meaning decision); as the term sheet says for Zion as a woman, Korean uses no feminine pronoun and in 7:10 says "그 원수", "그 여자" only at Literal where the Hebrew is a pronoun.

source.text: זַ֤עַף יְהוָה֙ אֶשָּׂ֔א כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אתִי ל֑וֹ עַד֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֤יב רִיבִי֙ וְעָשָׂ֣ה מִשְׁפָּטִ֔י יוֹצִיאֵ֣נִי לָא֔וֹר אֶרְאֶ֖ה בְּצִדְקָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] rage of Yahweh I will bear, for I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes my justice; he will bring me out to the light; I will look on his righteousness.

en.L: I will bear the rage of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q for I have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} contends for my cause and does justice for me. \q He will bring me out into the light; \q I will gaze on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} righteousness.
en.B: I will bear the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q because I have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} takes up my case and wins justice for me. \q He will bring me out into the light, \q and I will see {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} righteousness.
en.R: I have sinned against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q so I must suffer {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger \q until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} defends me and gives me justice. \q He will bring me out into the light, \q and I will see {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} righteousness as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sets things right.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ chịu cơn thịnh nộ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q vì tôi đã phạm tội nghịch cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} binh vực duyên cớ tôi và thi hành công lý cho tôi. \q Ngài sẽ đem tôi ra nơi ánh sáng; \q tôi sẽ chiêm ngưỡng sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ gánh chịu cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q vì tôi đã phạm tội nghịch cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đứng ra bênh vực tôi và xét xử công minh cho tôi. \q Ngài sẽ đem tôi ra nơi ánh sáng, \q và tôi sẽ thấy sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi đã phạm tội nghịch cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q nên tôi phải chịu cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bênh vực tôi và xét xử công bằng cho tôi. \q Ngài sẽ đem tôi ra nơi ánh sáng, \q và tôi sẽ thấy sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho mọi việc nên ngay thẳng.

fr.L: Je supporterai la fureur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q car j’ai péché contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} plaide ma cause et me fasse droit. \q Il me fera sortir à la lumière ; \q je contemplerai {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} justice.
fr.B: Je supporterai la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q parce que j’ai péché contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prenne ma cause en main et me rende justice. \q Il me fera sortir à la lumière, \q et je verrai {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} justice.
fr.R: J’ai péché contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q alors je dois supporter {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère, \q jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me défende et me rende justice. \q Il me fera sortir à la lumière, \q et je verrai {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} justice quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} remettra les choses en ordre.

sw.L: Nitaibeba ghadhabu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwa maana nimemtenda dhambi, \q mpaka atakaponitetea na kunitendea haki. \q Atanitoa nje kwenye nuru; \q nitaitazama haki {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Nitaivumilia hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwa sababu nimemtenda dhambi, \q mpaka atakapolichukua shauri langu na kunipatia haki. \q Atanileta nje kwenye nuru, \q nami nitaiona haki {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Nimemtenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhambi, \q kwa hiyo ni lazima nivumilie hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \q mpaka atakaponitetea na kunipa haki. \q Atanileta nje kwenye nuru, \q nami nitaiona haki {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} anapoyanyoosha mambo.

es.L: La ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} soportaré, \q porque he pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q hasta que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} defienda mi causa y me haga justicia. \q Él me sacará a la luz; \q contemplaré {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} justicia.
es.B: Soportaré el enojo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q porque he pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q hasta que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tome mi causa y me haga justicia. \q Él me sacará a la luz, \q y veré {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} justicia.
es.R: He pecado contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q así que tengo que sufrir {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enojo \q hasta que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me defienda y me haga justicia. \q Él me sacará a la luz, \q y veré {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} justicia cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ponga todo en orden.

ko.L: 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 분노를 짊어질 것이니, \q 내가 그분께 죄를 지었기 때문이다. \q 그분께서 나의 송사를 변론하시고 나를 위해 정의를 행하실 때까지 [그리할 것이다]. \q 그분께서 나를 빛으로 이끌어 내실 것이니, \q 내가 그분의 의를 바라볼 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 죄를 지었으니, \q 그분의 진노를 달게 받겠다. \q 그분께서 나의 사정을 변호하시고 나에게 정의를 찾아 주실 때까지 그리하겠다. \q 그분께서 나를 빛으로 이끌어 내실 것이니, \q 내가 그분의 의를 보게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 죄를 지었다. \q 그래서 나는 그분의 노여움을 견뎌야 한다. \q 그분께서 나를 변호하시고 나에게 정의를 찾아 주실 때까지 견뎌야 한다. \q 그분께서 나를 빛으로 이끌어 내실 것이다. \q 그분께서 모든 것을 바로잡으시는 것을 내가 보게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: I will bear the rage of the LORD, for I have sinned: Zion accepts his judgment as just
decisions.reason: Zion does not claim innocence. She owns her sin and bears the LORD's anger, trusting that it has an end (Lamentations 3:39-40; Isaiah 40:2). The same LORD who punishes will become her defender.

decisions.choice: until he pleads my case and executes justice for me: the LORD becomes her advocate
decisions.reason: The words are from the law court, as in 6:1-2. There the LORD had a case against his people; here he takes up their case against their enemies and gives them justice (Jeremiah 50:34; Lamentations 3:58-59).

decisions.choice: his righteousness: his faithfulness in setting things right for his people
decisions.reason: The LORD's righteousness here is not only that he is just, but his saving justice: the act by which he keeps his promises and puts his people in the right (Isaiah 46:13; 51:5). Zion will see it when he brings her out to the light.

decisions.choice: rage (L); anger (B, R); contends for my cause (L); takes up my case (B); defends me (R); righteousness (all levels); as he sets things right (R)
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "righteousness" and adds what it means here (m3). "He" at the start of a sentence is capitalized either way.

decisions.choice: "sự công chính" at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the LORD's faithfulness in setting things right; the Isaiah note gives "sự công chính" (L, B), and Readable keeps the noun because its clause explains it.

decisions.choice: B and R put "I have sinned" before "I will bear his anger"
decisions.reason: Korean states the reason before the result more naturally; Literal keeps the Hebrew order. The meaning (Zion accepts the judgment as just) is unchanged.

source.text: וְתֵרֶ֤א אֹיַ֨בְתִּי֙ וּתְכַסֶּ֣הָ בוּשָׁ֔ה הָאֹמְרָ֣ה אֵלַ֔י אַיּ֖וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יִךְ עֵינַי֙ תִּרְאֶ֣ינָּה בָּ֔הּ עַתָּ֛ה תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לְמִרְמָ֖ס כְּטִ֥יט חוּצֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And will see my enemy, and will cover her shame, who says to me, Where [is] he, Yahweh your God? My eyes will look on her; now she will become a trampling place like [the] mud of [the] streets.

en.L: And my enemy will see, \q and shame will cover her \q who said to me, "Where [is] he, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God?" \q My eyes will look upon her; \q now she will be trampled like the mud of the streets.
en.B: Then my enemy will see it, \q and shame will cover her, \q she who taunted me, "Where is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God?" \q My eyes will watch her downfall; \q now she will be trodden down like mud in the streets.
en.R: My enemy will see it and be ashamed. \q She said to me, \q "Where is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God?" \q Now I will see her defeated. \q She will be trampled like mud in the streets.

vi.L: Kẻ thù tôi sẽ thấy, \q và sự hổ thẹn sẽ bao phủ nó, \q là kẻ đã nói với tôi: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi ở đâu?" \q Mắt tôi sẽ nhìn nó; \q bây giờ nó sẽ bị giày đạp như bùn ngoài đường.
vi.B: Bấy giờ kẻ thù tôi sẽ thấy, \q và sự hổ thẹn sẽ phủ lấy nó, \q là kẻ đã chế nhạo tôi: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đâu rồi?" \q Mắt tôi sẽ thấy nó sụp đổ; \q bây giờ nó sẽ bị giày đạp như bùn ngoài đường phố.
vi.R: Kẻ thù tôi sẽ thấy và xấu hổ. \q Nó đã nói với tôi: \q "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đâu?" \q Bây giờ tôi sẽ thấy nó bị đánh bại. \q Nó sẽ bị giày đạp như bùn ngoài đường.

fr.L: Et mon ennemie verra, \q et la honte couvrira celle \q qui me disait : « Où [est-il], {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu ? » \q Mes yeux la regarderont ; \q maintenant elle sera piétinée comme la boue des rues.
fr.B: Alors mon ennemie le verra, \q et la honte la couvrira, \q elle qui me narguait : « Où est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu ? » \q Mes yeux verront sa chute ; \q maintenant elle sera piétinée comme la boue des rues.
fr.R: Mon ennemie le verra et elle aura honte. \q Elle me disait : \q « Où est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu ? » \q Maintenant je la verrai vaincue. \q Elle sera piétinée comme la boue des rues.

sw.L: Naye adui yangu ataona, \q na aibu itamfunika \q yeye aliyeniambia, "Yuko wapi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako?" \q Macho yangu yatamtazama; \q sasa atakanyagwa kama matope ya njiani.
sw.B: Ndipo adui yangu ataona, \q na aibu itamfunika, \q yeye aliyenidhihaki, "Yuko wapi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako?" \q Macho yangu yataona anguko lake; \q sasa atakanyagwa kama matope barabarani.
sw.R: Adui yangu ataona jambo hilo, naye ataaibika. \q Aliniambia, \q "Yuko wapi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako?" \q Sasa nitamwona akishindwa. \q Atakanyagwa kama matope barabarani.

es.L: Y lo verá mi enemiga, \q y la cubrirá la vergüenza, \q a la que me decía: «¿Dónde [está] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios?». \q Mis ojos la mirarán; \q ahora será pisoteada como el lodo de las calles.
es.B: Entonces mi enemiga lo verá, \q y la cubrirá la vergüenza, \q a ella, que se burlaba de mí: «¿Dónde está {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios?». \q Mis ojos verán su caída; \q ahora será pisoteada como el lodo de las calles.
es.R: Mi enemiga lo verá y quedará avergonzada. \q Ella me decía: \q «¿Dónde está {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios?». \q Ahora la veré derrotada. \q Será pisoteada como el lodo de las calles.

ko.L: 그러면 나의 원수가 보고, \q 수치가 그 여자를 덮을 것이다. \q 그 여자가 나에게 "그, 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 어디 있느냐?" 하고 말했다. \q 내 눈이 그 여자를 바라볼 것이니, \q 이제 그 여자가 거리의 진흙처럼 짓밟힐 것이다.
ko.B: 그때 나의 원수가 그것을 보고, \q 수치를 뒤집어쓸 것이다. \q 그 원수가 나에게 "너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 어디 있느냐?" 하고 조롱했다. \q 내 눈이 그 원수가 망하는 것을 지켜볼 것이다. \q 이제 그 원수가 거리의 진흙처럼 짓밟힐 것이다.
ko.R: 나의 원수가 그것을 보고 부끄러워할 것이다. \q 그 원수가 나에게 말했다. \q "너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 어디 있느냐?" \q 이제 나는 그 원수가 패하는 것을 보게 될 것이다. \q 그 원수는 거리의 진흙처럼 짓밟힐 것이다.

decisions.choice: Where is the LORD your God? The taunt of the enemies of God's people
decisions.reason: The question mocks a people whose God seems to have left them (Psalm 42:4, 11; 79:10; Joel 2:17). The enemy's taunt will be answered: the LORD will act, and the shame will be hers.

decisions.choice: my eyes will look upon her: I will see her downfall
decisions.reason: In 4:11 the nations wanted their eyes to gaze on Zion's ruin. Now it is turned around: Zion will see the fall of the one who mocked her.

decisions.choice: trampled like the mud of the streets: utterly humbled
decisions.reason: Mud in the street is trodden underfoot by everyone. The same picture is used of a defeated enemy in Isaiah 10:6 and Zechariah 10:5.

decisions.choice: Where [is] he, the LORD your God? (L); Where is the LORD your God? (B, R); My eyes will look upon her (L); My eyes will see her downfall (B); I will see her defeated (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "Where is he?" is followed by the name; Literal keeps both. Balanced and Readable say what the look means (m2).

decisions.choice: The enemy's taunt "너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 어디 있느냐?" without -시-
decisions.reason: The enemy speaks with contempt (meaning decision), so she gives the LORD no honorific, as hostile speakers do in the published Psalms [Ps 42:4].

source.text: י֖וֹם לִבְנ֣וֹת גְּדֵרָ֑יִךְ י֥וֹם הַה֖וּא יִרְחַק־חֹֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: A day for building your walls! That day, far off will be [the] boundary.

en.L: A day for building your walls! \q In that day the boundary will be far off.
en.B: A day is coming for building your walls; \q on that day your boundary will be extended far.
en.R: The day will come when your walls will be rebuilt. \q At that time your borders will be made much wider.

vi.L: Ngày xây các tường thành của ngươi! \q Trong ngày ấy ranh giới sẽ ở xa.
vi.B: Sẽ đến ngày xây lại các tường thành của ngươi; \q vào ngày ấy bờ cõi ngươi sẽ được mở rộng.
vi.R: Sẽ đến ngày các tường thành của ngươi được xây lại. \q Vào lúc ấy biên giới của ngươi sẽ được mở rộng thêm nhiều.

fr.L: Un jour pour bâtir tes murs ! \q En ce jour-là, la limite sera éloignée.
fr.B: Un jour vient où l’on bâtira tes murs ; \q ce jour-là, ta frontière sera repoussée au loin.
fr.R: Le jour viendra où tes murs seront reconstruits. \q En ce temps-là, tes frontières seront beaucoup plus larges.

sw.L: Siku ya kujenga kuta zako! \q Katika siku ile mpaka utakuwa mbali.
sw.B: Siku inakuja ya kujenga kuta zako; \q siku hiyo mpaka wako utapanuliwa mbali.
sw.R: Siku itakuja ambapo kuta zako zitajengwa upya. \q Wakati huo mipaka yako itapanuliwa sana.

es.L: ¡Día de edificar tus muros! \q Aquel día la frontera estará lejos.
es.B: Viene un día en que se edificarán tus muros; \q aquel día tu frontera se extenderá lejos.
es.R: Llegará el día en que tus muros serán reconstruidos. \q En ese tiempo tus fronteras se harán mucho más amplias.

ko.L: 너의 성벽을 쌓는 날이다! \q 그날에 경계가 멀리 [넓혀질 것이다].
ko.B: 너의 성벽을 다시 쌓을 날이 온다. \q 그날에 너의 경계가 멀리까지 넓혀질 것이다.
ko.R: 너의 성벽이 다시 세워질 날이 올 것이다. \q 그때에 너의 국경이 훨씬 넓어질 것이다.

decisions.choice: A day for building your walls: a promise to Zion
decisions.reason: The prophet now speaks to Zion ("your" is feminine). The line has no verb: it announces a day. The walls that the enemy pulled down will be rebuilt, as Amos 9:11 promises and as Nehemiah later did.

decisions.choice: the boundary will be far off: the borders will be extended
alternatives: the decree will be far off: the enemy's rule will be removed
decisions.reason: The word usually means a decree or statute, and also a boundary or limit (Job 26:10). Here, with the building of walls and the coming of many peoples (verse 12), it most likely means that the city's boundary will be pushed far out. It may mean that the decree imposed by the enemy will be removed.

decisions.choice: A day for building (L); A day is coming for building (B); The day will come when (R); In that day (L); on that day (B); At that time (R); far off (L); extended far (B); made much wider (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the verb the Hebrew leaves out, and say what the far-off boundary means (m2). "That day" follows the wording set for the prophets.

source.text: י֥וֹם הוּא֙ וְעָדֶ֣יךָ יָב֔וֹא לְמִנִּ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר וְעָרֵ֣י מָצ֑וֹר וּלְמִנִּ֤י מָצוֹר֙ וְעַד־נָהָ֔ר וְיָ֥ם מִיָּ֖ם וְהַ֥ר הָהָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: [In] that day, and to you will come, from Assyria and [the] cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to [the] River, and sea from sea and mountain [to] the mountain.

en.L: [It will be] that day, and [people] will come to you \q from Assyria and [from] the cities of Egypt, \q and from Egypt as far as the River, \q and sea from sea, and mountain [to] the mountain.
en.B: On that day people will come to you \q from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, \q from Egypt as far as the Euphrates, \q from sea to sea and from mountain to mountain.
en.R: At that time people will come to you \q from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, \q from Egypt all the way to the Euphrates River, \q from every sea and every mountain.

vi.L: [Đó sẽ là] ngày ấy, và [người ta] sẽ đến với ngươi \q từ A-si-ri và [từ] các thành của Ai Cập, \q và từ Ai Cập cho đến Sông, \q biển này đến biển kia, và núi này [đến] núi kia.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, người ta sẽ đến với ngươi \q từ A-si-ri và các thành của Ai Cập, \q từ Ai Cập cho đến sông Ơ-phơ-rát, \q từ biển này đến biển kia, từ núi này đến núi nọ.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, người ta sẽ đến với ngươi \q từ A-si-ri và các thành của Ai Cập, \q từ Ai Cập cho đến tận sông Ơ-phơ-rát, \q từ mọi miền biển và mọi miền núi.

fr.L: [Ce sera] ce jour-là, et [on] viendra jusqu’à toi \q de l’Assyrie et [des] villes d’Égypte, \q et de l’Égypte jusqu’au Fleuve, \q et mer depuis mer, et montagne [jusqu’à] la montagne.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, on viendra jusqu’à toi \q de l’Assyrie et des villes d’Égypte, \q de l’Égypte jusqu’à l’Euphrate, \q d’une mer à l’autre et d’une montagne à l’autre.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, des gens viendront jusqu’à toi \q de l’Assyrie et des villes d’Égypte, \q de l’Égypte jusqu’au fleuve Euphrate, \q de toutes les mers et de toutes les montagnes.

sw.L: [Itakuwa] siku ile, nao [watu] watakujia \q kutoka Ashuru na [kutoka] miji ya Misri, \q na kutoka Misri hata Mto, \q na bahari kutoka bahari, na mlima [hadi] mlima.
sw.B: Siku hiyo watu watakujia \q kutoka Ashuru na miji ya Misri, \q kutoka Misri mpaka mto Frati, \q kutoka bahari hadi bahari na kutoka mlima hadi mlima.
sw.R: Wakati huo watu watakujia \q kutoka Ashuru na miji ya Misri, \q kutoka Misri mpaka mto Frati, \q kutoka kila bahari na kila mlima.

es.L: [Será] aquel día, y vendrán a ti \q desde Asiria y [desde] las ciudades de Egipto, \q y desde Egipto hasta el Río, \q y de mar a mar, y de monte [a] monte.
es.B: Aquel día vendrá gente a ti \q desde Asiria y las ciudades de Egipto, \q desde Egipto hasta el Éufrates, \q de mar a mar y de monte a monte.
es.R: En ese tiempo vendrá gente a ti \q desde Asiria y las ciudades de Egipto, \q desde Egipto hasta el río Éufrates, \q desde todos los mares y todos los montes.

ko.L: 그날이 [오면], [사람들이] 너에게로 올 것이다, \q 앗시리아에서, 이집트의 성읍들에서, \q 이집트에서 강까지, \q 바다에서 바다까지, 산에서 산까지.
ko.B: 그날에 사람들이 너에게로 올 것이다. \q 앗시리아와 이집트의 성읍들에서, \q 이집트에서 유프라테스 강까지, \q 이 바다에서 저 바다까지, 이 산에서 저 산까지에서 올 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 사람들이 너에게로 올 것이다. \q 앗시리아와 이집트의 성읍들에서 올 것이다. \q 이집트에서부터 유프라테스 강까지, \q 모든 바다와 모든 산에서 올 것이다.

decisions.choice: from Assyria ... Egypt ... the River ... sea to sea: from every corner of the known world
decisions.reason: Assyria and Egypt were the two great powers, one to the north-east and one to the south-west. "The River" is the Euphrates. "From sea to sea and mountain to mountain" means from one end of the earth to the other (Psalm 72:8; Zechariah 9:10). Those who come may be Israel's scattered people coming home (Isaiah 11:11; 27:13), or the nations coming to Zion (4:1-2).

decisions.choice: Egypt: a poetic name that also means "fortress"
decisions.reason: The word used here for Egypt is a rare poetic form (2 Kings 19:24; Isaiah 19:6), which is spelled like the word for a siege or fortress (4:14). Some read "the fortified cities"; the pairing with Assyria points to Egypt.

decisions.choice: the River (L); the Euphrates (B); the Euphrates River (R); people (B, R); from every sea and every mountain (R)
decisions.reason: The River follows the wording set for the prophets. The Hebrew "he will come" names no one; Balanced and Readable say "people". Readable gives the sense of "sea to sea, mountain to mountain" (m1).

decisions.choice: "Mto" (L); "mto Frati" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "The River" is the Euphrates, named "Frati" as in the published Genesis and Ezra; Literal keeps the Hebrew's "the River" with a capital.

decisions.choice: "강" (L); "유프라테스 강" (B, R) for "the River"
decisions.reason: As the English: the River is the Euphrates [1 Kings 5:4 R]; Literal keeps the Hebrew's bare word.

source.text: וְהָיְתָ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ לִשְׁמָמָ֖ה עַל־יֹֽשְׁבֶ֑יהָ מִפְּרִ֖י מַֽעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And will become the earth a desolation on account of its inhabitants, from [the] fruit of their deeds.

en.L: And the earth will become a desolation because of its inhabitants, \q because of the fruit of their deeds.
en.B: But the earth will become desolate because of those who live in it, \q as the result of what they have done.
en.R: But the earth will become empty and ruined \q because of the evil things its people have done.

vi.L: Đất sẽ trở nên hoang tàn vì cớ dân cư của nó, \q vì bông trái của việc làm chúng.
vi.B: Nhưng đất sẽ trở nên hoang vu vì những kẻ sống trên đó, \q do hậu quả của những việc chúng đã làm.
vi.R: Nhưng đất sẽ trở nên trống trải và đổ nát \q vì những việc gian ác dân trên đất đã làm.

fr.L: Et la terre deviendra une désolation à cause de ses habitants, \q à cause du fruit de leurs actions.
fr.B: Mais la terre sera dévastée à cause de ceux qui l’habitent, \q à cause de ce qu’ils ont fait.
fr.R: Mais la terre deviendra vide et ruinée \q à cause du mal que ses habitants ont fait.

sw.L: Nayo dunia itakuwa ukiwa kwa sababu ya wakaaji wake, \q kwa sababu ya matunda ya matendo yao.
sw.B: Lakini dunia itakuwa ukiwa kwa sababu ya wanaoishi ndani yake, \q kama matokeo ya yale waliyotenda.
sw.R: Lakini dunia itakuwa tupu na kuharibika \q kwa sababu ya maovu ambayo watu wake wametenda.

es.L: Y la tierra se convertirá en desolación a causa de sus habitantes, \q por el fruto de sus obras.
es.B: Pero la tierra quedará desolada por causa de los que viven en ella, \q como resultado de lo que han hecho.
es.R: Pero la tierra quedará vacía y en ruinas \q por las cosas malas que ha hecho su gente.

ko.L: 그리고 땅이 그 주민들 때문에, \q 그들의 행위의 열매 때문에 황폐해질 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 땅은 거기 사는 사람들 때문에, \q 그들이 한 일의 결과로 황폐해질 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 온 땅은 텅 비고 폐허가 될 것이다. \q 그곳 사람들이 저지른 악한 일들 때문이다.

decisions.choice: the earth: the lands of the nations, judged while Zion is restored
alternatives: the land of Israel, before it is restored
decisions.reason: The word means the earth or a land. After the world-wide picture of verse 12, it most likely means the earth, the nations that refused to listen (5:14), which will be laid waste. Some read it as Israel's own land, left desolate for its people's sins before the restoration of verses 11-12.

decisions.choice: the fruit of their deeds: the result of what they have done
decisions.reason: What people do grows into what they reap (Jeremiah 17:10; 21:14; Proverbs 1:31). The desolation is not arbitrary; it is the harvest of their own deeds.

decisions.choice: And (L); But (B, R); the fruit of their deeds (L); what they have done (B); the evil things its people have done (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "but" to mark the contrast with the promise to Zion (m1), and give the sense of the picture of fruit (m2).

source.text: רְעֵ֧ה עַמְּךָ֣ בְשִׁבְטֶ֗ךָ צֹ֚אן נַֽחֲלָתֶ֔ךָ שֹׁכְנִ֣י לְבָדָ֔ד יַ֖עַר בְּת֣וֹךְ כַּרְמֶ֑ל יִרְע֥וּ בָשָׁ֛ן וְגִלְעָ֖ד כִּימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Shepherd your people with your rod, [the] flock of your inheritance, dwelling alone, [in] a forest in [the] midst of Carmel; let them graze [in] Bashan and Gilead as [in the] days of old.

en.L: Shepherd {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} staff, the flock of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} inheritance, \q dwelling alone, \q [in] a forest in the midst of Carmel; \q let them graze [in] Bashan and Gilead as in ancient days.
en.B: Shepherd {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} staff, the flock that belongs to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q which lives alone \q in a forest in the middle of Carmel. \q Let them graze in Bashan and Gilead as they did long ago.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, care for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people like a shepherd with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} staff. They are {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own flock, \q living alone \q in a forest near the rich land of Carmel. \q Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as they did long ago.

vi.L: Xin hãy dùng cây gậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăn dắt dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là bầy chiên thuộc cơ nghiệp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q sống đơn độc \q [trong] rừng giữa Cạt-mên; \q xin cho chúng được ăn cỏ [ở] Ba-san và Ga-la-át như những ngày xưa.
vi.B: Xin dùng cây gậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà chăn dắt dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là bầy chiên thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q bầy sống riêng một mình \q trong rừng giữa Cạt-mên. \q Xin cho chúng được ăn cỏ ở Ba-san và Ga-la-át như thuở trước.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin cầm gậy chăm sóc dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như người chăn chiên. Họ là bầy chiên của riêng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q sống đơn độc \q trong khu rừng gần miền đất màu mỡ Cạt-mên. \q Xin cho họ được ăn cỏ ở Ba-san và Ga-la-át như ngày xưa.

fr.L: Fais paître {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple avec {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} houlette, le troupeau de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} héritage, \q qui habite seul \q [dans] une forêt au milieu du Carmel ; \q qu’ils paissent [dans] le Bashân et Galaad comme aux jours d’autrefois.
fr.B: Fais paître {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple avec {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} houlette, le troupeau qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartient, \q qui vit à l’écart \q dans une forêt au milieu du Carmel. \q Qu’ils paissent dans le Bashân et en Galaad comme autrefois.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, prends soin de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple comme un berger, avec {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} houlette. C’est {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propre troupeau, \q qui vit à l’écart \q dans une forêt, près des riches terres du Carmel. \q Qu’ils trouvent leur nourriture dans le Bashân et en Galaad, comme autrefois.

sw.L: Uwachunge watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa fimbo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kundi la urithi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q wanaokaa peke yao, \q [katika] msitu katikati ya Karmeli; \q na wale malisho [katika] Bashani na Gileadi kama katika siku za kale.
sw.B: Uwachunge watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa fimbo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kundi lililo mali {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, \q linaloishi peke yake \q katika msitu katikati ya Karmeli. \q Na wale malisho katika Bashani na Gileadi kama walivyofanya zamani.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uwatunze watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kama mchungaji kwa fimbo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. Wao ni kundi {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} mwenyewe, \q wanaoishi peke yao \q katika msitu karibu na nchi nzuri ya Karmeli. \q Waache wale malisho katika Bashani na Gileadi, kama walivyofanya zamani.

es.L: Pastorea a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cayado, al rebaño de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} heredad, \q que habita solo, \q [en] un bosque en medio del Carmelo; \q que pasten [en] Basán y Galaad como en los días antiguos.
es.B: Pastorea a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cayado, al rebaño que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pertenece, \q que vive solo \q en un bosque en medio del Carmelo. \q Que pasten en Basán y Galaad como lo hacían hace mucho tiempo.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuida de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo como un pastor con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cayado. Ellos son {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} propio rebaño, \q que vive solo \q en un bosque cerca de la rica tierra del Carmelo. \q Déjalos comer en Basán y Galaad, como lo hacían hace mucho tiempo.

ko.L: 주님의 지팡이로 주님의 백성, 주님의 유산인 양 떼를 치십시오. \q [그들은] 홀로 살고 있습니다, \q 갈멜 한가운데 있는 숲속에서. \q 옛날처럼 그들이 바산과 길르앗에서 풀을 뜯게 하십시오.
ko.B: 주님의 지팡이로 주님의 백성, 주님께 속한 양 떼를 돌보아 주십시오. \q 그들은 홀로 \q 갈멜 한가운데 있는 숲속에서 살고 있습니다. \q 옛날처럼 그들이 바산과 길르앗에서 풀을 뜯게 해 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 목자가 지팡이를 들고 양을 돌보듯이 주님의 백성을 돌보아 주십시오. 그들은 주님의 양 떼입니다. \q 그들은 따로 떨어져 \q 기름진 땅 갈멜 가까이 있는 숲속에서 살고 있습니다. \q 옛날처럼 그들이 바산과 길르앗에서 풀을 먹게 해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: Shepherd your people: the prayer of the prophet for his people
decisions.reason: Verses 14-20 are a prayer to the LORD. The prophet asks the LORD to be the shepherd of his people, the role the ruler of 5:3 was promised (compare Psalm 28:9; 80:2). The LORD's answer seems to come in verse 15.

decisions.choice: the flock of your inheritance, dwelling alone: the LORD's own people, set apart
decisions.reason: Israel is the LORD's inheritance, the people that belong to him (Deuteronomy 9:29). "Dwelling alone" recalls Balaam's words, "a people dwelling alone" (Numbers 23:9; compare Deuteronomy 33:28): set apart, and safe. The staff is the shepherd's rod for guiding and protecting (Psalm 23:4).

decisions.choice: a forest in the midst of Carmel; Bashan and Gilead: the richest pasture lands
alternatives: in the midst of garden land
decisions.reason: Carmel is the wooded ridge on the coast, and its name also means garden land or orchard, so the line may mean "in the midst of fertile land". Bashan and Gilead, east of the Jordan, were famous for their pastures and herds (Jeremiah 50:19). They had been taken by Assyria (2 Kings 15:29). The prayer asks for the flock to graze again where it did "in the days of old".

decisions.choice: Shepherd (L, B); care for ... like a shepherd (R); the flock of your inheritance (L); the flock that belongs to you (B); your own flock (R); Carmel (all levels)
decisions.reason: All the "you" and "your" here are spoken to God and carry the setting for pronouns for God. Readable adds the address "LORD" so that it is clear who is spoken to (m1).

decisions.choice: the prophet prays to the LORD as "Ngài", with "Xin" for the request and "Lạy CHÚA" at R
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the prophet's prayer for his people; the Isaiah note's address for a prophet praying. Cạt-mên, Ba-san and Ga-la-át are the published forms.

decisions.choice: The prayer of 7:14-20 in 합쇼체, addressing God as "주님"; "갈멜", "바산", "길르앗"
decisions.reason: The prophet prays for his people (meaning decision); prayer is 합쇼체 as in the Psalms, and the places have their published spellings.

source.text: כִּימֵ֥י צֵאתְךָ֖ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אַרְאֶ֖נּוּ נִפְלָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: As [in the] days of your going out from [the] land of Egypt I will show him wonders.

en.L: As in the days of your coming out from the land of Egypt, \q I will show him wonders.
en.B: As in the days when you came out of the land of Egypt, \q I will show them wonders.
en.R: I will do amazing things for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, \q as I did when they came out of Egypt.

vi.L: Như trong những ngày ngươi ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho nó thấy những phép lạ.
vi.B: Như trong những ngày các ngươi ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho họ thấy những việc diệu kỳ.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm những việc lạ lùng cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm khi họ ra khỏi Ai Cập.

fr.L: Comme aux jours de ta sortie du pays d’Égypte, \q je lui ferai voir des merveilles.
fr.B: Comme aux jours où tu sortis du pays d’Égypte, \q je lui ferai voir des merveilles.
fr.R: Je ferai des choses extraordinaires pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, \q comme lorsqu’il est sorti d’Égypte.

sw.L: Kama katika siku za kutoka kwako katika nchi ya Misri, \q nitamwonyesha maajabu.
sw.B: Kama katika siku ulipotoka katika nchi ya Misri, \q nitawaonyesha maajabu.
sw.R: Nitawatendea watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mambo ya ajabu, \q kama nilivyofanya walipotoka Misri.

es.L: Como en los días de tu salida de la tierra de Egipto, \q le mostraré maravillas.
es.B: Como en los días en que saliste de la tierra de Egipto, \q les mostraré maravillas.
es.R: Haré cosas asombrosas por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, \q como hice cuando salieron de Egipto.

ko.L: 네가 이집트 땅에서 나오던 날들처럼, \q 내가 그에게 놀라운 일들을 보여 주겠다.
ko.B: 네가 이집트 땅에서 나오던 때처럼, \q 내가 그들에게 놀라운 일들을 보여 주겠다.
ko.R: 내 백성이 이집트에서 나올 때에 내가 한 것처럼, \q 나는 그들에게 놀라운 일들을 보여 주겠다.

decisions.choice: I will show him wonders: the LORD answers the prayer
alternatives: show us wonders: the prayer continues
decisions.reason: The verse speaks in the LORD's voice ("I will show"), answering verse 14. "You" is the people, addressed as one; "him" is the same people, spoken of as Israel. The change of persons is abrupt, and some read "show us", which would keep the prayer going.

decisions.choice: as in the days of the exodus: a second exodus of wonders
decisions.reason: The "wonders" are the signs the LORD did in Egypt and at the sea (Exodus 3:20; 15:11; Psalm 78:12). The prophets promise a new exodus, greater than the first (Isaiah 43:16-19; Jeremiah 23:7-8).

decisions.choice: your coming out ... show him (L); you came out ... show them (B); my people ... they came out (R); wonders (L, B); amazing things (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "them" for the people spoken of as "him"; Readable puts the people in the third person throughout and puts the comparison second.

decisions.choice: "phép lạ" (L); "những việc diệu kỳ" (B); "những việc lạ lùng" (R)
decisions.reason: "Dấu lạ" is kept for "sign" (style guide); the Hebrew word here is wonders, as at the exodus. The meaning footnote: the LORD answers the prayer, and Literal keeps the Hebrew's "you ... him".

decisions.choice: The LORD answers in 해라체 with "나"
decisions.reason: The LORD answers the prayer (meaning decision), and God speaks in 해라체; "그에게" (L) keeps the Hebrew singular, which B and R make plural as the English does.

source.text: יִרְא֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ וְיֵבֹ֔שׁוּ מִכֹּ֖ל גְּבֽוּרָתָ֑ם יָשִׂ֤ימוּ יָד֙ עַל־פֶּ֔ה אָזְנֵיהֶ֖ם תֶּחֱרַֽשְׁנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Nations will see and be ashamed of all their might; they will put a hand on [the] mouth; their ears will be deaf.

en.L: Nations will see and be ashamed, \q from all their might; \q they will put [their] hand on [their] mouth; \q their ears will be deaf.
en.B: The nations will see and be ashamed, \q for all their power; \q they will lay their hands on their mouths; \q their ears will be deafened.
en.R: The nations will see this and be ashamed, \q even with all their power. \q They will cover their mouths in shock. \q Their ears will go deaf.

vi.L: Các nước sẽ thấy và hổ thẹn, \q với tất cả sức mạnh của chúng; \q chúng sẽ đặt tay lên miệng; \q tai chúng sẽ bị điếc.
vi.B: Các nước sẽ thấy và hổ thẹn, \q dù chúng có đầy quyền lực; \q chúng sẽ lấy tay bịt miệng; \q tai chúng sẽ ra điếc.
vi.R: Các nước sẽ thấy điều này và xấu hổ, \q dù chúng có quyền lực lớn đến đâu. \q Chúng sẽ lấy tay che miệng vì kinh ngạc. \q Tai chúng sẽ điếc đi.

fr.L: Les nations verront et seront honteuses, \q de toute leur puissance ; \q elles mettront [la] main sur [la] bouche ; \q leurs oreilles deviendront sourdes.
fr.B: Les nations verront et seront couvertes de honte, \q malgré toute leur puissance ; \q elles mettront la main sur leur bouche ; \q leurs oreilles seront assourdies.
fr.R: Les nations verront cela et auront honte, \q même avec toute leur puissance. \q Elles se couvriront la bouche, stupéfaites. \q Leurs oreilles deviendront sourdes.

sw.L: Mataifa yataona na kuaibika, \q kwa nguvu zao zote; \q wataweka mkono juu ya kinywa; \q masikio yao yatakuwa viziwi.
sw.B: Mataifa yataona na kuaibika, \q pamoja na nguvu zao zote; \q wataweka mikono yao vinywani mwao; \q masikio yao yatazibwa.
sw.R: Mataifa yataona jambo hili na kuaibika, \q hata pamoja na nguvu zao zote. \q Watafunika vinywa vyao kwa mshangao. \q Masikio yao yatakuwa viziwi.

es.L: Verán las naciones y se avergonzarán \q de todo su poderío; \q pondrán [la] mano sobre [la] boca; \q sus oídos se ensordecerán.
es.B: Las naciones lo verán y quedarán avergonzadas \q con todo su poder; \q se taparán la boca con la mano; \q sus oídos quedarán sordos.
es.R: Las naciones verán esto y se avergonzarán, \q aun con todo su poder. \q Se taparán la boca asombradas. \q Se quedarán sordas.

ko.L: 민족들이 보고 \q 그들의 모든 힘을 부끄러워할 것이며, \q [자기] 손을 [자기] 입에 댈 것이고, \q 그들의 귀가 먹을 것이다.
ko.B: 민족들이 보고, \q 그 모든 힘에도 불구하고 부끄러워할 것이다. \q 그들은 손으로 입을 막을 것이고, \q 귀가 먹먹해질 것이다.
ko.R: 민족들이 이것을 보고 부끄러워할 것이다. \q 그들이 아무리 강해도 소용없을 것이다. \q 그들은 놀라서 손으로 입을 가릴 것이다. \q 그들의 귀가 먹을 것이다.

decisions.choice: ashamed of all their might: their power will count for nothing
decisions.reason: When the nations see the LORD's wonders, all their power will seem shameful and useless to them. The words may also mean "ashamed, for all their might": in spite of it.

decisions.choice: a hand on the mouth ... deaf ears: speechless and stunned
decisions.reason: To put a hand over the mouth is to fall silent in awe or shame (Job 21:5; 40:4; Isaiah 52:15). Their ears will be as if deaf, stunned by what they have heard.

decisions.choice: see this (R); [their] hand on [their] mouth (L); in shock (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the gesture means (m2).

decisions.choice: "wataweka mkono juu ya kinywa" (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no "their", and Swahili reads naturally without it, so Literal needs no bracketed words where the English brackets "[their]".

source.text: יְלַחֲכ֤וּ עָפָר֙ כַּנָּחָ֔שׁ כְּזֹחֲלֵ֣י אֶ֔רֶץ יִרְגְּז֖וּ מִמִּסְגְּרֹֽתֵיהֶ֑ם אֶל־יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ֙ יִפְחָ֔דוּ וְיִֽרְא֖וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: They will lick dust like the serpent, like crawling things of [the] earth; they will come trembling from their strongholds; to Yahweh our God they will come in dread, and they will be afraid of you.

en.L: They will lick dust like the serpent, \q like the crawling things of the earth; \q they will come trembling out of their strongholds; \q to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God they will come in dread, \q and they will fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: They will lick the dust like a serpent, \q like creatures that crawl on the ground. \q They will come trembling out of their fortresses; \q they will turn in dread to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God \q and will be afraid of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: They will crawl in the dust like snakes, \q like creatures that crawl on the ground. \q They will come out of their forts, shaking with fear. \q They will turn to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God in terror, \q and they will be afraid of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

vi.L: Chúng sẽ liếm bụi như con rắn, \q như các loài bò sát trên đất; \q chúng sẽ run rẩy ra khỏi các đồn lũy mình; \q chúng sẽ kinh hãi đến với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi, \q và chúng sẽ sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Chúng sẽ liếm bụi như con rắn, \q như các loài bò sát trên mặt đất. \q Chúng sẽ run rẩy ra khỏi các thành trì; \q chúng sẽ kinh hãi quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi \q và sẽ sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Chúng sẽ bò trong bụi đất như rắn, \q như các loài bò sát trên mặt đất. \q Chúng sẽ run sợ ra khỏi các đồn lũy. \q Chúng sẽ kinh hoàng quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi, \q và chúng sẽ sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

fr.L: Elles lécheront la poussière comme le serpent, \q comme les reptiles de la terre ; \q elles sortiront en tremblant de leurs forteresses ; \q vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu elles viendront avec effroi, \q et elles {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craindront.
fr.B: Elles lécheront la poussière comme un serpent, \q comme les bêtes qui rampent sur le sol. \q Elles sortiront de leurs forteresses en tremblant ; \q elles se tourneront avec effroi vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu \q et elles auront peur de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
