fr.R: Elles ramperont dans la poussière comme des serpents, \q comme les bêtes qui rampent sur le sol. \q Elles sortiront de leurs forteresses en tremblant de peur. \q Elles se tourneront, terrifiées, vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q et elles auront peur de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Watalamba mavumbi kama nyoka, \q kama vitambaavyo vya nchi; \q watatoka katika ngome zao wakitetemeka; \q watamjia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu kwa hofu, \q nao watakuogopa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.
sw.B: Watalamba mavumbi kama nyoka, \q kama viumbe vitambaavyo ardhini. \q Watatoka katika ngome zao wakitetemeka; \q watamgeukia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu kwa hofu \q na kukuogopa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.
sw.R: Watatambaa mavumbini kama nyoka, \q kama viumbe vitambaavyo ardhini. \q Watatoka katika ngome zao wakitetemeka kwa hofu. \q Watamgeukia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu wakiwa na hofu kuu, \q nao watakuogopa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.

es.L: Lamerán el polvo como la serpiente, \q como los reptiles de la tierra; \q saldrán temblando de sus fortalezas; \q {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios vendrán con pavor, \q y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temerán.
es.B: Lamerán el polvo como una serpiente, \q como los animales que se arrastran por el suelo. \q Saldrán temblando de sus fortalezas; \q se volverán con pavor {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios \q y tendrán miedo de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Se arrastrarán por el polvo como las serpientes, \q como los animales que se arrastran por el suelo. \q Saldrán de sus fuertes temblando de miedo. \q Se volverán aterrados {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, \q y tendrán miedo de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

ko.L: 그들이 뱀처럼, \q 땅을 기는 것들처럼 티끌을 핥을 것이며, \q 그들의 요새에서 떨며 나올 것입니다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님께 두려워하며 나아오고, \q 주님을 두려워할 것입니다.
ko.B: 그들은 뱀처럼, \q 땅을 기어 다니는 것들처럼 티끌을 핥을 것이며, \q 그들의 요새에서 떨며 나올 것입니다. \q 그들이 두려워하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님께 돌아오고, \q 주님을 두려워할 것입니다.
ko.R: 그들은 뱀처럼 먼지 속을 기어 다닐 것입니다. \q 땅을 기는 짐승들처럼 될 것입니다. \q 그들은 무서워 떨면서 그들의 요새에서 나올 것입니다. \q 그들이 두려워하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님께 돌아오고, \q 주님을 무서워할 것입니다.

decisions.choice: lick dust like the serpent: the deepest humiliation
decisions.reason: The serpent was cursed to eat dust (Genesis 3:14). To lick the dust is to lie face down before a conqueror (Psalm 72:9; Isaiah 49:23). The nations that mocked Zion will bow to the ground.

decisions.choice: to the LORD our God they will come in dread: the nations turn to him in fear
decisions.reason: Hosea 3:5 says that Israel will "come trembling to the LORD and to his goodness". Here the nations come trembling out of their fortresses to the LORD. The fear may be dread of judgment, or the awe that begins to worship, as in 4:1-2. In the last line the prayer speaks to God again ("you").

decisions.choice: the serpent (L); a serpent (B); snakes (R), as Genesis 3:14; strongholds (L); fortresses (B); forts (R)
decisions.reason: The word for the creature follows the published Genesis 3:14. Readable says what licking dust pictures: crawling in the dust in defeat (m1).

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi", with "chúng tôi"
decisions.reason: The speaker prays to God ("they will fear you"), so the people say "chúng tôi", which leaves God outside the "we", rather than the inclusive "chúng ta".

decisions.choice: 7:17 in 합쇼체, since it ends by addressing the LORD ("주님을 두려워할 것입니다")
decisions.reason: The verse speaks of the nations and ends in direct address to God (the English deity_pronoun "you"); Korean keeps one speech level for the verse so the prayer reads as one voice.

source.text: מִי־אֵ֣ל כָּמ֗וֹךָ נֹשֵׂ֤א עָוֺן֙ וְעֹבֵ֣ר עַל־פֶּ֔שַׁע לִשְׁאֵרִ֖ית נַחֲלָת֑וֹ לֹא־הֶחֱזִ֤יק לָעַד֙ אַפּ֔וֹ כִּֽי־חָפֵ֥ץ חֶ֖סֶד הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: Who [is] a God like you, forgiving iniquity and passing over transgression for [the] remnant of his inheritance? Not he holds on forever [to] his anger, for delighting in loyal love [is] he.

en.L: Who [is] a God like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, bearing iniquity and passing over transgression \q for the remnant of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} inheritance? \q He does not hold on to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger forever, \q for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} delights in loyal love.
en.B: Who is a God like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, who forgives wrongdoing and passes over rebellion \q for the remnant of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} inheritance? \q He does not keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger forever, \q because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} delights in loyal love.
en.R: Who is a God like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? \q He forgives sin and overlooks the rebellion of the people who are left, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own people. \q He does not stay angry forever, \q because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loves to show faithful love.

vi.L: Có Đức Chúa Trời nào giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, Đấng tha thứ gian ác và bỏ qua tội vi phạm \q cho những người sót lại thuộc cơ nghiệp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? \q Ngài không giữ cơn giận mãi mãi, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui thích tình yêu thương thành tín.
vi.B: Có Đức Chúa Trời nào như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, Đấng tha thứ gian ác và bỏ qua tội ác \q cho những người sót lại thuộc cơ nghiệp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? \q Ngài không giữ cơn giận đến đời đời, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui thích tình yêu thương thành tín.
vi.R: Có Đức Chúa Trời nào giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? \q Ngài tha thứ tội lỗi và bỏ qua sự phản nghịch của những người còn sống sót, là dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài không giận mãi mãi, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thích bày tỏ tình thương thành tín.

fr.L: Qui [est] un Dieu comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, qui porte l’iniquité et passe sur la transgression \q pour le reste de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} héritage ? \q Il ne garde pas {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère pour toujours, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prend plaisir à l’amour loyal.
fr.B: Quel Dieu est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, qui pardonne la faute et passe sur la rébellion \q pour le reste de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} héritage ? \q Il ne garde pas {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère pour toujours, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prend plaisir à l’amour fidèle.
fr.R: Quel Dieu est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ? \q Il pardonne le péché et oublie la révolte de ceux qui restent, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre peuple. \q Il ne reste pas en colère pour toujours, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aime montrer {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle.

sw.L: Ni Mungu gani aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, anayechukua uovu na kupita juu ya maasi \q kwa ajili ya mabaki ya urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}? \q Hashikilii hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} milele, \q kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hupendezwa na upendo usiokoma.
sw.B: Ni Mungu gani aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, anayesamehe uovu na kupita juu ya makosa \q kwa ajili ya mabaki ya urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}? \q Haidumishi hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} milele, \q kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hupendezwa na upendo usiokoma.
sw.R: Ni Mungu gani aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}? \q Anasamehe dhambi na kuachilia maasi ya watu waliobaki, watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe. \q Hakai na hasira milele, \q kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anapenda kuonyesha upendo usiokoma.

es.L: ¿Quién [es] un Dios como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, que carga con la iniquidad y pasa por alto la transgresión \q del remanente de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} heredad? \q No retiene para siempre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se deleita en el amor fiel.
es.B: ¿Qué Dios hay como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, que perdona la maldad y pasa por alto el delito \q del remanente de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} heredad? \q No guarda {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enojo para siempre, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se deleita en el amor fiel.
es.R: ¿Qué Dios hay como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}? \q Perdona el mal y pasa por alto el pecado de los que quedan, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio pueblo. \q No se queda enojado para siempre, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} disfruta mostrando amor fiel.

ko.L: 주님 같은 하나님이 누구입니까? 주님께서는 죄악을 용서하시고, 그분의 유산 가운데 남은 자의 허물을 넘겨 주십니다. \q 그분께서는 노여움을 영원히 품지 않으십니다. \q 그분께서는 한결같은 사랑을 기뻐하시기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 주님 같은 하나님이 어디 있겠습니까? 주님께서는 죄악을 용서하시고, \q 그분의 유산 가운데 남은 자들의 허물을 덮어 주십니다. \q 그분께서는 노여움을 영원히 품지 않으십니다. \q 한결같은 사랑을 기뻐하시기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 주님 같은 하나님이 또 어디 있겠습니까? \q 그분께서는 죄를 용서하시고, 그분의 백성 가운데 살아남은 사람들의 반역을 덮어 주십니다. \q 그분께서는 언제까지나 화를 내지 않으십니다. \q 변함없는 사랑을 베풀기를 좋아하시기 때문입니다.

decisions.choice: Who is a God like you? The question in Micah's own name
decisions.reason: Micah's name means "Who is like the LORD?", and the book ends by asking it. The Song of the Sea asks the same: "Who is like you among the gods, LORD?" (Exodus 15:11). Here what makes the LORD unlike any other is not only his power but his forgiveness.

decisions.choice: forgiving iniquity ... loyal love: the words of Exodus 34:6-7
decisions.reason: When the LORD passed before Moses he proclaimed himself "great in loyal love", "keeping loyal love to thousands, bearing iniquity and transgression and sin" (Exodus 34:6-7). Micah takes up the same words: bearing iniquity, transgression, loyal love, and in verse 19 compassion, and verse 20 adds faithfulness. Joel 2:13 and Jonah 4:2 also echo that passage.

decisions.choice: passing over transgression: overlooking it, not holding it against them
decisions.reason: To "pass over" an offense is to let it go (Proverbs 19:11). In Amos 7:8 and 8:2 the LORD said he would "never again pass by" Israel, that is, spare it; here he passes over the sin of the remnant. "The remnant of his inheritance" is the people that survives the judgment (2:12; 4:7; 5:6-7).

decisions.choice: he delights in loyal love: steadfast, faithful love is what he takes pleasure in
decisions.reason: *Hesed* is the loyal, faithful love that keeps a bond even when the other side has broken it. God's anger is real, but it does not last; his loyal love does (Psalm 30:6; 103:9; Isaiah 54:7-8).

decisions.choice: loyal love (L, B); faithful love (R)
decisions.reason: *Hesed* follows the wording set for the prophets, "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced and "faithful love" at Readable, here and in verse 20, pending the founder's ruling on the wording of Exodus 34:6, which these verses echo (the published Exodus has "steadfast love" at Literal and "faithful love" at Balanced and Readable). If that ruling settles one wording for every echo of Exodus 34:6, these verses follow it.

decisions.choice: bearing iniquity (L); forgives wrongdoing (B); forgives sin (R), as Exodus 34:7; transgression (L); rebellion (B, R)
decisions.reason: The phrase reuses its wording in the published Exodus 34:7 at each level. Readable joins the two lines into a statement after the question.

decisions.choice: "tha thứ gian ác" and "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B) / "tình thương thành tín" (R), as the published Exodus 34:6-7
decisions.reason: The meaning decision names Exodus 34:6-7; its Vietnamese words for forgiving iniquity and for hesed are kept. "Who is a God like you?" echoes Micah's own name ("Who is like Yah?"), which the English notes carry.

decisions.choice: "qui porte l'iniquité" (L), "qui pardonne la faute" (B), "pardonne le péché" (R), as the published Exodus 34:7 senses; ḥesed "amour loyal" (L), "amour fidèle" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The English meaning decision points to Exodus 34:6-7; French Balanced says "amour fidèle" where the English Balanced says "loyal love", as the term sheet sets.

decisions.choice: "anayechukua uovu" (L); "anayesamehe uovu" (B); "upendo usiokoma" at every level
decisions.reason: The line echoes Exodus 34:6-7, and Literal has "akiuchukua uovu" there; hesed stays "upendo usiokoma" as everywhere in the prophets.

decisions.choice: "죄악", "허물" (L, B), "죄", "반역" (R); "한결같은 사랑" (L, B), "변함없는 사랑" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Exodus 34:6-7 (meaning decision) take the Korean Exodus terms (iniquity "죄악", transgression "허물") and the settled *hesed* words. The question is to God in 합쇼체; the next lines speak of him in the third person, still in 합쇼체 because the whole is addressed to him. "Who is a God like you" plays on Micah's name; the footnote of the English decision explains it.

decisions.choice: "carga con la iniquidad" (L); "perdona la maldad" (B); "Perdona el mal" (R)
decisions.reason: The line echoes Exodus 34:7, so each level reuses that verse's Spanish for the first verb; "transgresión / delito / pecado" follow the settled words for peshaʿ.

decisions.choice: "amor fiel" at every level
decisions.reason: Verses 18-20 echo Exodus 34:6-7, so hesed takes Spanish Exodus 34:6's word, "amor fiel", at every level, here and in verse 20, as in Joel 2:13 and Jonah 4:2. Elsewhere in the prophets Literal has "amor leal" (Micah 6:8 keeps it).

records.literal_gloss: He will again have compassion on us; he will tread down our iniquities; and you will cast into [the] depths of [the] sea all their sins.

en.L: He will again have compassion on us; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will tread down our iniquities; \q and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will cast into the depths of the sea all their sins.
en.B: He will again show us compassion \q and trample our wrongdoings underfoot. \q You will hurl all their sins into the depths of the sea.
en.R: He will be kind to us again. \q He will crush our sins under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet. \q You will throw all the sins of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people into the deepest sea.

vi.L: Ngài sẽ lại thương xót chúng tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giày đạp các gian ác của chúng tôi; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ném mọi tội lỗi của chúng vào đáy biển sâu.
vi.B: Ngài sẽ lại tỏ lòng thương xót chúng tôi \q và giày đạp các tội ác chúng tôi dưới chân. \q Ngài sẽ quăng mọi tội lỗi của chúng xuống đáy biển sâu.
vi.R: Ngài sẽ lại nhân từ với chúng tôi. \q Ngài sẽ giày nát tội lỗi chúng tôi dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài sẽ ném mọi tội lỗi của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xuống đáy biển sâu thẳm.

fr.L: Il aura encore compassion de nous ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} foulera nos iniquités ; \q et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} jetteras dans les profondeurs de la mer tous leurs péchés.
fr.B: Il aura de nouveau compassion de nous \q et foulera aux pieds nos fautes. \q Tu lanceras tous leurs péchés au fond de la mer.
fr.R: Il sera de nouveau bon pour nous. \q Il écrasera nos péchés sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds. \q Tu jetteras tous les péchés de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple au plus profond de la mer.

sw.L: Atatuhurumia tena; \q atayakanyaga maovu yetu; \q {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} utazitupa katika vilindi vya bahari dhambi zao zote.
sw.B: Atatuonea huruma tena \q na kuyakanyaga makosa yetu chini ya miguu. \q Utazitupa dhambi zao zote katika vilindi vya bahari.
sw.R: Atatufanyia wema tena. \q Atazikanyaga dhambi zetu chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Utazitupa dhambi zote za watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} katika vilindi vya bahari.

es.L: Volverá a compadecerse de nosotros; \q pisoteará nuestras iniquidades; \q y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} arrojarás a las profundidades del mar todos sus pecados.
es.B: Volverá a mostrarnos compasión \q y pisoteará nuestras maldades. \q Arrojarás todos sus pecados a lo profundo del mar.
es.R: Volverá a ser bondadoso con nosotros. \q Aplastará nuestros pecados bajo {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies. \q Arrojarás todos los pecados de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo a lo más profundo del mar.

ko.L: 그분께서 다시 우리를 불쌍히 여기시고, \q 우리의 죄악들을 짓밟으실 것입니다. \q 주님께서 그들의 모든 죄를 바다 깊은 곳에 던지실 것입니다.
ko.B: 그분께서 다시 우리를 불쌍히 여기시고, \q 우리의 죄악을 발로 짓밟으실 것입니다. \q 주님께서 그들의 모든 죄를 깊은 바다에 내던지실 것입니다.
ko.R: 그분께서 다시 우리에게 자비를 베푸실 것입니다. \q 우리의 죄를 발로 짓밟아 버리실 것입니다. \q 주님께서 주님의 백성의 모든 죄를 깊은 바닷속에 던져 버리실 것입니다.

decisions.choice: he will again have compassion: the tender love of Exodus 34:6
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the word "compassionate" in Exodus 34:6, a love like a parent's for a child (Psalm 103:13). "Again" (literally "he will turn") means that he will turn back to them in mercy after his anger.

decisions.choice: tread down our iniquities ... cast all their sins into the depths of the sea: sin conquered and gone for good
decisions.reason: Sins are pictured as enemies, trampled underfoot, and then thrown into the deep where no one can bring them back. The words recall the sea that swallowed Egypt's army: "the depths covered them; they sank to the bottom like a stone" (Exodus 15:5).

decisions.choice: all their sins: as the Hebrew text has it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "their sins": the sins of the remnant (verse 18), the people who say "us". The ancient Greek translation and some other ancient versions read "our sins", matching "our iniquities". The prayer moves between speaking of God and speaking to him, and between "us" and "them", and the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: have compassion (L); show compassion (B); be kind (R); iniquities (L); wrongdoings (B); sins (R); all their sins (L, B); the sins of your people (R)
decisions.reason: The word for iniquity follows the wording set for the prophets. Readable says whose sins are meant (m3); "your" is spoken to God.

decisions.choice: "불쌍히 여기다" (L, B); "자비를 베풀다" (R) for *racham*
decisions.reason: As the term sheet: the compassion (*rachamim*) words are "긍휼, 불쌍히 여기다" and at Readable "자비".

records.literal_gloss: You will give faithfulness to Jacob, loyal love to Abraham, which you swore to our fathers from [the] days of old.

en.L: You will give faithfulness to Jacob, \q loyal love to Abraham, \q as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} swore to our {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} from the days of old.
en.B: You will show faithfulness to Jacob \q and loyal love to Abraham, \q as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} promised our {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} on oath long ago.
en.R: You will be faithful to the people of Jacob. \q You will show faithful love to the descendants of Abraham, \q as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} promised our {{gender:ancestors|forefathers}} long ago.

vi.L: Ngài sẽ ban sự thành tín cho Gia-cốp, \q tình yêu thương thành tín cho Áp-ra-ham, \q như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thề với tổ tiên chúng tôi từ những ngày xưa.
vi.B: Ngài sẽ bày tỏ sự thành tín với Gia-cốp \q và tình yêu thương thành tín với Áp-ra-ham, \q như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thề hứa với tổ tiên chúng tôi từ thuở xa xưa.
vi.R: Ngài sẽ thành tín với dân Gia-cốp. \q Ngài sẽ bày tỏ tình thương thành tín với con cháu Áp-ra-ham, \q như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với tổ tiên chúng tôi từ lâu.

fr.L: Tu donneras la fidélité à Jacob, \q l’amour loyal à Abraham, \q comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as juré à nos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} depuis les jours d’autrefois.
fr.B: Tu montreras {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité à Jacob \q et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle à Abraham, \q comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as promis par serment à nos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} il y a longtemps.
fr.R: Tu seras fidèle au peuple de Jacob. \q Tu montreras {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle aux descendants d’Abraham, \q comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as promis à nos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} il y a longtemps.

sw.L: Utampa Yakobo uaminifu, \q Abrahamu upendo usiokoma, \q kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyowaapia baba zetu tangu siku za kale.
sw.B: Utamwonyesha Yakobo uaminifu \q na Abrahamu upendo usiokoma, \q kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyowaahidi babu zetu kwa kiapo zamani.
sw.R: Utakuwa mwaminifu kwa watu wa Yakobo. \q Utawaonyesha wazao wa Abrahamu upendo usiokoma, \q kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyowaahidi babu zetu zamani.

es.L: Darás fidelidad a Jacob, \q amor fiel a Abraham, \q como juraste a nuestros padres desde los días antiguos.
es.B: Mostrarás fidelidad a Jacob \q y amor fiel a Abraham, \q como lo prometiste con juramento a nuestros antepasados hace mucho tiempo.
es.R: Serás fiel al pueblo de Jacob. \q Mostrarás amor fiel a los descendientes de Abraham, \q como lo prometiste a nuestros antepasados hace mucho tiempo.

ko.L: 주님께서 야곱에게 신실함을, \q 아브라함에게 한결같은 사랑을 베푸실 것입니다. \q 주님께서 옛날부터 우리 조상들에게 맹세하신 대로 [그리하실 것입니다].
ko.B: 주님께서 야곱에게 신실함을 보이시고, \q 아브라함에게 한결같은 사랑을 베푸실 것입니다. \q 오래전에 주님께서 우리 조상들에게 맹세하신 대로 그리하실 것입니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 야곱 백성에게 신실하실 것입니다. \q 아브라함의 자손에게 변함없는 사랑을 베푸실 것입니다. \q 오래전에 주님께서 우리 조상들에게 약속하신 대로 그리하실 것입니다.

decisions.choice: faithfulness ... loyal love: the pair of Exodus 34:6
decisions.reason: The LORD is "great in loyal love and faithfulness" (Exodus 34:6), and the two words go together through the Psalms (Psalm 25:10; 89:15). Faithfulness is reliability, being true to one's word; loyal love keeps the bond. The book ends where verse 18 began, with the LORD's character.

decisions.choice: as you swore to our fathers: the oath to Abraham and Jacob
decisions.reason: The LORD swore to Abraham to bless him and his descendants (Genesis 22:16-18), and repeated the promise to Isaac and Jacob (Genesis 26:3; 28:13-15). Moses reminds Israel that the LORD keeps the oath he swore to their fathers (Deuteronomy 7:8, 12). Zechariah's song in Luke 1:72-73 recalls "the oath that he swore to our father Abraham".

decisions.choice: Jacob ... Abraham: the patriarchs and the people descended from them
decisions.reason: The names stand for the ancestors and also for their descendants, the people who bear their names. The promises made to the fathers are kept to their children.

decisions.choice: give (L); show (B, R); faithfulness (L, B); be faithful (R); loyal love (L, B); faithful love (R); swore (L); promised on oath (B); promised (R); ancestors (with the gender setting)
decisions.reason: *Hesed* follows the wording set for the prophets, pending the founder's ruling on the echoes of Exodus 34:6 (see verse 18). "Fathers" here means the ancestors of the people, so it takes the gender setting. Readable says that the names stand for the people (m3).

decisions.choice: "tổ tiên" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Tổ tiên" names ancestors of both sexes, as the published 1 Kings 19:4 has it; there is no second Vietnamese wording to offer. "Sự thành tín ... tình yêu thương thành tín" keeps the Exodus 34:6 pair the meaning decision names.

decisions.choice: "baba zetu" (L); "babu zetu" (B, R) with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Babu" (forebears) is the ordinary Swahili for ancestors, as the published 1 Kings 19:4; the English gender span has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: "우리 조상들" with no gender span; "신실함", "한결같은 사랑" as Exodus 34:6
decisions.reason: Korean "조상" includes both men and women, so the English gender span has nothing to change. The pair faithfulness and loyal love is that of Exodus 34:6 (meaning decision), in the Korean Exodus words.

decisions.choice: "nuestros padres" (L); "nuestros antepasados" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "padres" and "antepasados" already include women, as published 1 Kings 19:4 has it.
